injuries.shortComment: Campbell logged five tackles (one solo) and three passes defensed, including one interception, in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Campbell's three defended passes matched his season total heading into the contest. The cornerback's biggest moment of the day was intercepting C.J. Stroud at the Cleveland 24-yard line with 48 seconds left in the first half. Campbell's turnover likely stole at least three points from the Texans in a game that was decided by the same swing.

injuries.shortComment: Schwesinger logged 13 tackles (eight solo) in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Schwesinger continues to be a model of consistency, having played all 658 defensive snaps for the Browns in 2026. The middle linebacker has logged double-digit tackles in six of the team's 10 contests so far, adding 3.0 sacks and three forced fumbles over that span.

injuries.shortComment: Corley caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in addition to returning two kicks for 51 yards during Cleveland's win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Corley had not caught a pass across the first nine games of the campaign before hauling in three passes during Sunday's victory. He ended up finishing the contest third on the team in receiving yards behind Harold Fannin and Jerry Jeudy.

injuries.shortComment: Wallace caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Texans. He also recorded one tackle in kick coverage.
injuries.longComment: Wallace again played a rotational role in Week 10, logging 13 snaps at wide receiver. He was able to draw a season-high two targets and come down with both of them, making him one of eight Browns to catch a pass from quarterback Deshaun Watson Sunday. Barring an injury to one of the wideouts ahead of him on the depth chart, he doesn't have a clear path to more consistent playing time following Cleveland's bye in Week 11.

injuries.shortComment: Szmyt made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Szmyt knocked through field goals from 49 and 26 yards in Sunday's contest. The kicker stumbled in the fourth quarter, missing a 54-yard attempt with 11:02 remaining that would've brought the game within a point. Szmyt is now 21-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-16 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: McLaughlin was limited to one snap on offense and none on special teams in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Since Week 7, McLaughlin has logged just three snaps on offense in the Browns' ensuing three games, but prior to Sunday, he still appeared to be in the mix for work on kickoff returns. However, Isaiah Bond and Malachi Corley have since taken over as the team's preferred kickoff returners, leaving McLaughlin without a role on special teams. McLaughlin will likely continue to see little use as Cleveland's No. 3 back behind Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson.

injuries.shortComment: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

injuries.shortComment: Jeudy recorded two catches on four targets for 74 yards in a 27-24 victory over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Jeudy boosted his final line considerably on a 65-yard connection with Deshaun Watson in the second period. Watson carried the ball into the end zone on the following snap to bring the Browns to within seven points. Jeudy's 74 receiving yards were a season-high mark, though he finished with two or fewer receptions for the third straight week. The veteran wideout is behind both WRs Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion, not to mention tight end Harold Fannin, in the pass-catcher pecking order, so he may need to rely on big plays to have a chance to make an impact for fantasy managers.

injuries.shortComment: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.
injuries.longComment: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

injuries.shortComment: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
injuries.longComment: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Williams injured his back during the fourth quarter of Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles, but the veteran defensive lineman will have extra time to rest before the Cowboys' Week 13 tilt against the Seahawks on Monday, Dec. 7, Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reports.
injuries.longComment: Williams recorded four tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, before leaving late in the fourth quarter due to back spasms. He was not cleared to return to Thursday's game, but there doesn't appear to be much concern over his status for Week 13 given the extra rest that Dallas will have.

injuries.shortComment: Spann-Ford caught his lone target for 15 yards during Dallas' loss to the Eagles on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Spann-Ford served as the team's starting tight end for the third consecutive game as Jake Ferguson remains sidelined with a knee injury. However, Spann-Ford had a quiet outing but will look to play a larger role next week versus the Seahawks if Ferguson is out again.

injuries.shortComment: Aubrey converted one of his two field-goal attempts and all five of his extra-point tries during Dallas' 39-38 loss to the Eagles on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Aubrey missed a kick from 40 yards out in the fourth quarter, which ended up being the difference in the game. The 31-year-old has now converted 21 of his 26 field-goal attempts and 36 of his 38 extra-point tries across 12 games this season and will look to bounce back during next week's matchup against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Pickens caught five of nine targets for 67 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: It was a step back for Pickens after he hauled in 18 of 28 targets for 247 yards and four TDs over the prior two games. The 25-year-old wideout is the clear No. 2 option in the Dallas passing attack behind CeeDee Lamb, but the team's woeful defense and limited depth behind the duo ensures that Pickens will see big volume from Dak Prescott more often than not. Pickens will take a 62-847-6 line on 99 targets into a Week 13 clash with the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Lamb caught seven of 11 targets for 134 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: He was once again Dak Prescott's top downfield option, leading the Cowboys in targets, catches and receiving yards, but KaVontae Turpin and Javonte Williams were on the other end of the QB's touchdown passes. Lamb has topped 100 yards in six of 12 games this season, including three of the last four, and he'll carry a 95-1,242-9 line on 144 targets into a tough Week 13 battle against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while catching all three of his targets for 22 yards and a third TD in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: All three scores came in the first half as the Cowboys raced out to a 28-10 lead, making Williams the first player with three TDs in a half on Thanksgiving since Brian Westbrook accomplished the feat with Philly in 2008. Williams is also the second RB in Cowboys history to have multiple games in a season with three or more scores, something Emmitt Smith pulled off in four separate campaigns. He's also reached 100 rushing yards in three of the last six games, and he's topped 1,000 yards from scrimmage for the second straight year in Dallas. Williams will look to keep rolling in Week 13 against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries.
injuries.longComment: The Cowboys held a 28-10 lead at the half and were up 38-24 early in the fourth quarter, but abysmal efforts by the defense and special teams squandered Prescott's third straight game producing at least three touchdowns. It was the first time since Week 8 that he failed to reach 300 passing yards, but the 33-year-old QB is still on course for a career-best campaign. He'll take a 27:7 TD:INT, along with three rushing scores, into a much tougher Week 13 tilt against the Seahawks.

injuries.shortComment: Thompson (hamstring) is listed as active Thursday against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Thompson last suited up in Week 3 against the Ravens in Rio de Janeiro, as he's missed the last two months due to a hamstring injury that required an IR stint. He likely will slot back in as the Cowboys' starting strong safety in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Moore (hip) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Moore strung together three consecutive full practices during Week 12 prep, but he would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Thanksgiving Day. The rookie fourth-rounder has yet to make his 2026 regular-season debut due to a hip injury that he picked up in training camp.

injuries.shortComment: Barham (hip/groin) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Hip and groin injuries prevented Barham from playing in Week 11 against the Titans, but his full session Wednesday was enough for him to avoid a designation for Thanksgiving Day. The rookie third-rounder has accumulated 37 tackles (21 solo) and one forced fumble through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Locke (concussion) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.
injuries.longComment: Locke entered the league's concussion protocol following the Cowboys' Week 9 win over the Colts. He hasn't progressed enough in his recovery to return for Thanksgiving Day and will thus miss a third consecutive game. Locke's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Seahawks on Monday, Dec. 7.

injuries.shortComment: Mingo (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Mingo's absence for Thanksgiving Day will be his third missed game in a row due to an ankle injury that he sustained in Week 9 against the Colts. His absence means KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown will continue to operate in rotational roles on offense behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Ryan Flournoy. Mingo's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Seahawks on Monday, Dec. 7.

injuries.shortComment: Winters (knee) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Eagles.
injuries.longComment: Winters suffered a knee injury against the Titans on Sunday, but his full practice Wednesday was enough for him to avoid a designation ahead of Thanksgiving Day. The fourth-year linebacker has accumulated 45 tackles (30 solo), one interception and one fumble recovery across nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: The Cowboys elevated Corbin from the practice squad Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: The running back will again be active as Javonte Williams' backup after rushing five times for 32 yards, adding one catch for five yards on one target, across 18 offensive snaps last Sunday against the Titans.

injuries.shortComment: Downs recorded seven tackles (five solo) in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The No. 11 overall pick in the 2026 Draft, Downs has started all 11 games this season and has piled up 73 tackles (40 solo), including 2.0 sacks, three pass breakups, including an interception, and two forced fumbles on 92 percent of the Cowboys' defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: James recorded six tackles (three solo) in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The second-year linebacker has started each of the last five games for Dallas and has played at least 88 percent of the defensive snaps in all of them. With Dee Winters (knee) injured against Tennessee, James should remain in the starting lineup Thursday against the Eagles. James has 44 tackles (28 solo), one interception and a fumble recovery across 11 contests this season.

injuries.shortComment: Houston recorded four tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The fifth-year edge rusher entered Sunday with 1.5 sacks on the season, so he more than doubled that number with his big game. With Malachi Lawrence (ankle) on injured reserve, Houston's snaps have been dialed up over the last three games. Through seven contests this season, Houston has 18 tackles (nine solo), including 3.5 sacks, and six QB hits.

injuries.shortComment: Schoonmaker caught his lone target for six yards in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: With Jake Ferguson (knee) remaining out for Dallas, Schoonmaker played 25 of 65 offensive snaps behind Brevyn Spann-Ford. Schoonmaker ran 12 routes, five fewer than Spann-Ford, and the duo combined to see three targets on a day Dak Prescott attempted 33 passes. Schoonmaker has five catches for 48 yards on six targets across nine games this season and has no fantasy appeal.

injuries.shortComment: Bland (ankle) is expected to return this season, Calvin Watkins of  The Dallas Morning News reports.
injuries.longComment: Bland was placed on injured reserve Sunday after suffering an ankle injury during the Week 10 loss to the 49ers, but the injury is not expected to be season-ending. The earliest Bland will be eligible to make his return is the Week 16 matchup versus Jacksonville, and Ameer Speed and Cobie Durant should continue to see increased playing time in his absence.

injuries.shortComment: Mitchell recorded two receptions for 40 yards on two targets in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The fifth-year tight end was one of eight pass catchers that quarterback Dak Prescott connected with on the afternoon, with the pair of receptions marking Mitchell's first two grabs of the season. Mitchell took the field for 15 of the Cowboys' 65 snaps on offense, but he could wind up seeing most of his playing time on special teams once top tight end Jake Ferguson is cleared to return from the knee injury that has sidelined him for the past two games.

injuries.shortComment: Flournoy caught just one pass for 11 yards on one target in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The Cowboys' slot receiver drew just one look on Dak Prescott's 33 pass attempts. He'd caught multiple passes in all 10 games leading up to Sunday's contest. A favorite target of Prescott in the red zone, Flournoy will try to rebound at home against the Eagles on Thanksgiving, when he'll be playable on three-game fantasy slates for Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Turpin failed to reel in his only target while rushing twice for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans. He added 121 yards as a kick returner and logged a 13-yard punt return.
injuries.longComment: Turpin went without a catch for the fourth time this season, but he was able to make his mark as a rusher in Week 11. The wideout was able to break loose for a 22-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, notching his second score on the ground this season. Turpin has now caught five of 11 targets for 49 yards, rushed five times for 60 yards and two touchdowns, and added 695 kick-return yards and 121 yards as a punt returner over eight contests so far during the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos placed Jones (hamstring) on injured reserve Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Jones had previously been ruled out for Friday's matchup versus the Steelers but will now be forced to miss at least four games before he's eligible to return. In his absence, Tyler Onyedim should be in line for increased playing time.

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos signed Schrader off the practice squad to the active roster Thursday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Schrader reached the maximum three games of elevation from the practice squad, but now that he's on the active roster, the Missouri product is eligible to suit up for the Broncos moving forward. He returned three kickoffs for 71 yards in Week 11 against the Raiders, and with J.K. Dobbins serving a one-game suspension, Schrader would operate as the team's RB2 or RB3 behind Jonah Coleman against the Steelers on Friday depending on whether Tyler Badie (thumb) is activated from injured reserve.

injuries.shortComment: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Lohner was a full participant in all three practice sessions during Week 12 prep. However, the second-year pro is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, so his next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Dec. 6. Lohner is in the final stages of his recovery from a procedure on his foot in June.

injuries.shortComment: Badie (thumb) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Since being designated for return from injured reserve Tuesday, Badie has been listed as a 'full' participant on each of his team's three practice reports ahead of Week 12. With RJ Harvey (knee) not yet ready to return from IR and J.K. Dobbins set to serve a team-imposed suspension this week, Badie is in a position to serve in a backup role behind ascending rookie Jonah Coleman, provided he's activated from IR by Friday afternoon. Also potentially in the mix on that front is practice-squad member Cody Schrader.

injuries.shortComment: Rapp (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Steelers, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Rapp was limited in each of the first two practices of Week 12 prep due to a quad injury that he may have picked up during the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders on Sunday, when he logged two tackles (one solo). He will not travel with the team to Pittsburgh, so his next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Dec. 6. JL Skinner, Devon Key and Jahdae Barron are all candidates to see a bump in defensive snaps in Rapp's absence.

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos placed Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list Wednesday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Head coach Sean Payton had previously announced Tuesday that Dobbins would be suspended for Friday's game against the Steelers due to conduct detrimental to the team, but it wasn't immediately clear whether or not the running back would count toward the 53-man roster. As a result of Wednesday's transaction, the Broncos will now have an open roster spot to use for Week 12, and Tyler Badie (thumb) could be activated from injured reserve to help fill the void in the backfield. Dobbins' suspension came after he played just one snap in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders on Sunday, when rookie Jonah Coleman took on a bell-cow role and handled 28 touches.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (hamstring) was listed as a full participant at the Broncos' walkthrough practice Tuesday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official practice reports.
injuries.longComment: Jones has missed the team's last two games while nursing a hamstring injury, but he now appears to be all set to return to action Friday against the Steelers. The 28-year-old will have a couple more chances to officially practice before potentially returning to his starting role at free safety in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Elliss (ankle) did not participate in Tuesday's practice and is unlikely to be designated to return from injured reserve ahead of Friday's game against the Steelers, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Tuesday was Denver's first practice, and given Elliss's absence, he's highly unlikely to participate in any of the Broncos' next two sessions ahead of Black Friday. The third-year linebacker is recovering from an ankle injury that landed him on IR in late October. Assuming he doesn't play in Week 12, Elliss's next opportunity to play would be Week 13 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Singleton recorded 11 total tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, while also adding a pass defensed during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Singleton was able to notch double-digit stops for the fourth time in the last five games and sixth time overall this year. The linebacker also notched a sack for the third time in four weeks, getting to Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza for a 10-yard loss in the second quarter. Singleton is now up to 118 total tackles (54 solo), including 3.0 sacks, while also registering three passes defensed over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: McMillian recorded eight total tackles (four solo), a forced fumble and a pick-six during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: McMillian had himself a day in Week 11, finishing second on the team in takedowns behind linebacker Alex Singleton (11). The cornerback was also able to strip Raiders running back Mike Washington in the third quarter, but Washington jumped on the loose ball. McMillian's biggest moment of the game came in the fourth quarter, however, when he notched a 35-yard pick-six on an outside pass from quarterback Fernando Mendoza with two minutes left in regulation. McMillian has now registered 39 total tackles (25 solo), including 3.0 sacks, while also adding two interceptions, including Sunday's pick-six, and a forced fumble over 10 contests this season.

injuries.shortComment: Franklin did not record a catch in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: The wide receiver did see two targets, but he wasn't able to haul them in. Franklin has just 17 targets across 10 games this year, recording nine catches for 100 yards and no scores.

injuries.shortComment: Trautman caught his only target for a one-yard touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Trautman leaked open behind Las Vegas' defense on a play-action pass from the goal line early in the second quarter, giving Denver a 10-0 lead. He still has a big role in the Broncos' offense, but he isn't running enough routes to sustain pass-catching production worth fantasy consideration in most formats.

injuries.shortComment: Mims caught one of two targets for 36 yards and also added an 11-yard rush and 22 yards as a punt returner during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Mims reeled in just one pass for the second straight game, but his 36-yard snag in the second quarter was enough to notch his second-highest receiving yardage total in a contest this year. The wideout played just 15 snaps on offense, which ranked fifth at his position behind Courtland Sutton (49), Pat Bryant (40), Jaylen Waddle (39) and Troy Franklin (24) for Denver in Week 11. Mims will remain an unappealing fantasy option ahead of Friday's matchup with the Steelers.

injuries.shortComment: Lutz made his lone field-goal attempt and all five PATs in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: The veteran kicker now has gone five straight games without missing a kick, as he's 9-for-9 on field goals and 14-for-14 on extra points in that span. With the Denver offense heating up after a slow start to the campaign, Lutz has become useful in fantasy. On the season, he's 17-for-20 on FGAs and has made all 21 of his PATs.

injuries.shortComment: Adkins recorded a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Adkins was on the field for 30 of the Broncos' 73 snaps on offense, with his 41 percent share representing a season-high mark. The fourth-year tight end out of South Carolina has mainly served as a blocking specialist for Denver, having thus far been limited to a 7-47-3 receiving line on nine targets to go with a six-yard carry through 10 appearances on the season.

injuries.shortComment: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks, making it difficult for any of the pass catchers to post big numbers in the box score.

injuries.shortComment: Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Sutton thus was blanked in the box score for the first time Week 7 of the 2024 campaign, a span of 39 games (including playoffs). Considering he's surpassed 50 receiving yards just one time in 10 appearances in 2026, he doesn't hold much sway for fantasy purposes, especially in a Broncos offense that often has sputtered this season. Sutton's next chance to turn the tide arrives Friday at Pittsburgh.

injuries.shortComment: Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: It was easily Engram's best performance of the season, as he set season highs in targets, catches and yards against Las Vegas. Entering Sunday, Engram had produced just seven grabs for 48 yards total over his previous four games. Engram and the Broncos have a quick turnaround ahead of Friday's date with the Steelers. The tight end will be a low-floor fantasy option for that one.

injuries.shortComment: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.

injuries.shortComment: Waddle secured three of six targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Waddle sustained a concussion in the Broncos' last game in Week 9 at Carolina, but with the benefit of a Week 10 bye, he had enough time to gain clearance from the protocol for head injuries and miss no additional time as a result. With a 24-yard connection with QB Bo Nix on Sunday, Waddle now has recorded exactly one catch of at least that distance in four straight games. Unfortunately for Waddle's fantasy managers, his 61 receiving yards marked his second most of the campaign after a 138-yard outburst in Week 2 against the Jaguars, so he remains an underwhelming asset in most formats.

injuries.shortComment: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.
injuries.longComment: Since returning from an IR stint due to a sprained ankle in Week 7, Coleman has increased his touch count in four consecutive contests, taking a stranglehold on the Broncos backfield in the process. As evidence, his 25 touches easily outpaced fellow RB J.K. Dobbins' one, which went for no yards. Coleman, a rookie fourth-round pick, also cracked the 100-yard mark on the ground for the first time in his career. With RJ Harvey (ankle) on injured reserve for at least one more game, Coleman again is set to act as a workhorse in Friday's road matchup with the Steelers.

injuries.shortComment: Vaki carried the ball six times for 19 yards and hauled in two of his three targets for a loss of four yards during Detroit's loss to Chicago on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Vaki once again served a limited role as Jahmyr Gibbs continues to handle the bulk of the workload. The 25-year-old has totaled 181 rushing yards on 43 carries, in addition to catching 11 of his 13 targets for 84 yards across 11 games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Bates made both of his field-goal attempts and three of his four extra-point tries during Detroit's 39-35 loss to the Bears on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Bates' missed extra point came from 48 yards out due to a 15-yard taunting penalty. The 27-year-old has now converted 19 of his 21 field-goal attempts and 36 of his 37 extra-point tries across 11 games this season.

injuries.shortComment: LaPorta caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Despite the high score, Jared Goff threw only one TD pass on the afternoon, connecting with LaPorta for an 11-yard strike in the second quarter, The tight end snapped a five-game touchdown drought in the process, but he still hasn't topped four catches or 62 yards in six contests since Detroit's bye. LaPorta will take a 43-521-4 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Williams caught six of nine targets for 68 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 12 yards on his lone carry.
injuries.longComment: The fifth-year wideout finished second on the Lions in targets, catches and receiving yards to Amon-Ra St. Brown (7-146-0 on 10 targets), a position that Williams is very used to finding himself in. Williams tied his season high in receptions with the performance, and he'll take a 42-679-6 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.
injuries.longComment: The veteran QB topped 300 passing yards for the fifth time this season, but Goff's only touchdown came on an 11-yard connection with Sam LaPorta in the second quarter, as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. Goff has thrown multiple TDs in just two of the last five games, a stretch in which he's managed a 7:5 TD:INT, but he could pop for a ceiling game in Week 13 against a struggling Falcons defense.

injuries.shortComment: St. Brown caught seven of 10 targets for 146 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: It was the third time this season St. Brown has hauled in more than 140 yards in a game, but he got shut out of the end zone as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. St. Brown has caught at least seven passes in four of the last six games, and through 11 contests he's racked up a 77-938-8 line on 107 targets. He'll look to reach 1,000 yards for the fifth straight season in Week 13 on the road against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 47 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injuries.longComment: The superstar running back was already headed for a career-best season coming into Week 12, but Gibbs took things to another level on Thanksgiving, producing his third career game with three rushing scores and his second with 200-plus rushing yards. The 252 scrimmage yards also tied his season high, a mark he reached just two weeks ago against the Patriots. Gibbs leads the NFL with 1,754 scrimmage yards, and given his current form he could reach 2,000 as soon as next week, on the road against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Ratledge (ankle/knee) returned to Thursday's contest against the Bears, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
injuries.longComment: Ratledge had his lower leg rolled up on in the first quarter but was able to rejoin the lineup as the Lions' right guard one possession later.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez suffered an ankle injury during Thursday's game against the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Rodriguez has his ankle rolled up on in the third quarter and immediately made his way to the sideline tent before the Lions deemed him questionable to return. He had four tackles and a fumble recovery before his exit.

injuries.shortComment: Wonnum (back) is inactive for Thursday's Week 12 battle against the Bears.
injuries.longComment: Wonnum was able to practice in a limited capacity Wednesday, but that didn't end up being enough for him to suit up Thursday. He leads the Lions with 7.0 sacks this season, so the veteran defensive end's absence is a big deal for Detroit. Tyler Lacy, Ahmed Hassanein, Eric O'Neill and Anthony Lucas could all be involved in trying to fill the void left by Wonnum's absence Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Clark (hamstring) is inactive for Thursday's clash against Chicago.
injuries.longComment: Clark dealt with a hamstring issue during Week 12 prep and is going to miss his first game of the campaign as a result. He's been a starter at safety for the Lions all season and played every defensive snap in three of Detroit's past four games. Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch will start at safety Thursday, with Andre Cisco working in reserve.

injuries.shortComment: The Lions placed Gill-Howard (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Gill-Howard suffered a season-ending knee injury during the Lions' Week 11 win over the Buccaneers. The rookie sixth-rounder will finish his first NFL campaign with 11 tackles (two solo), including 2.0 sacks, across 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Branch logged six tackles (one solo) and two passes defensed in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Branch played 98 percent of the Lions' defensive snaps in the contest. The strong safety has now had two passes defensed in consecutive weeks, totaling five in his five regular-season games in 2026. Sunday's game marked the first of 2026 that Branch and free safety Kirby Joseph played alongside each other, and they could certainly help shore up the back end of the defense down the stretch.

injuries.shortComment: Ya-Sin logged 10 tackles (nine solo) in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Ya-Sin played 59 defensive snaps in the contest and one snap on special teams. The cornerback played 91 percent of the team's defensive snaps, drawing the start due to the absence of Ennis Rakestraw (shoulder). Ya-Sin could see an elevated role again in Week 12 on Thursday against the Bears if Rakestraw remains sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Saylors recorded 29-yard kickoff return during Sunday's 31-21 win over Tampa Bay.
injuries.longComment: Saylors didn't record any stats over two snaps on offense while recording 29 yards on his only kick return of the day in Week 11. The running back will continue to be unintriguing fantasy option while operating as an extreme depth option behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Sione Vaki in Detroit's backfield moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: TeSlaa failed to catch any of his three targets during Sunday's 31-21 win over the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: TeSlaa went without a reception for the second time in four weeks, and he has now gone six straight games without exceeding 20 receiving yards. The wide receiver played 23 snaps on offense, ranking third at his position behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (46) and Jameson Williams (45). TeSlaa will continue to be an unreliable fantasy option ahead of the team's Week 12 matchup with the Bears on Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Wright caught both of two targets for 42 yards during Sunday's 31-21 win versus the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: One of Wright's two grabs in Week 11 was a 27-yard strike up the seam, easily his longest reception of the season thus far. He was on the field for 43 of the Lions' 58 offensive snaps Sunday, but he spent a substantial majority of those on blocking assignments for tailback Jahmyr Gibbs and company. His role in a Thanksgiving tilt versus the Bears may depend somewhat on the health of running mate Sam LaPorta, who was limited during Monday's walkthrough with an ankle issue.

injuries.shortComment: Reed (hip) was considered to be a full participant at the Lions' walkthrough practice Monday.
injuries.longComment: Reed appears to be on track to return to action Thursday against the Bears after missing three straight games with a hip injury. The cornerback will have two more chances to officially practice ahead of Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Dorsey (wrist) has re-entered Sunday's matchup against Tampa Bay, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.
injuries.longComment: Dorsey hurt his wrist early in Sunday's game and was initially deemed questionable to return. The veteran cornerback has since been able to re-enter the game, albeit with a club over the hand that he injured. Dorsey has been working in a rotational role at cornerback, logging a defensive snap share between 32 and 38 percent three straight weeks.

injuries.shortComment: Lacy (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Lacy was limited in practice all week due to a shoulder injury, but he's been cleared to play in Sunday's home game. He's expected to take on an elevated role at defensive end in the absence of Aidan Hutchinson, who is out for the rest of the season due to a torn ACL. Lacy has accumulated 12 tackles (four solo) through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Smack made both of his field-goal tries and his lone extra-point attempt Wednesday in a loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Neither of Smack's field goals were chip shots; he nailed a 54-yarder late in the first quarter and a 48-yarder late in the second. The rookie entered Wednesday having gone just 15-for-21 on FG tries over his first 10 NFL games, so his accuracy Wednesday may have given him some needed job security. The most impressive aspect of Smack's rookie campaign has been his big leg. Despite his overall struggles, he's gone 4-for-5 on FG tries from 50-plus yards away.

injuries.shortComment: Moore returned three kickoffs for 48 yards and one punt for 11 yards Wednesday in a loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Moore continued to serve as Green Bay's primary kick and punt returner, but he logged just one snap on offense. That limited usage as a receiver was even more concerning for his fantasy outlook given that star wideout Christian Watson couldn't play at all in the second half due to a concussion. Moore did notch 14 targets over his first five games, but since returning in Week 10 from a stint on IR, he's played just one offensive snap over two contests.

injuries.shortComment: Melton finished Wednesday's Thanksgiving Eve loss to the Rams with one rush for three yards and two catches (on three targets) for 20 yards. He also returned two kickoffs for 31 yards.
injuries.longComment: Melton's carry was his first of the season, so he hasn't been a weapon in that regard. However, he did step up a bit as a receiver, notching multiple receptions for the first time since he logged a season-high three catches in Week 5. Melton's main role this season has been as a kick returner, so he's well off the fantasy radar.

injuries.shortComment: Williams carried twice for 18 yards and caught one of three targets for three yards against the Rams in a Thanksgiving Eve loss Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: It was another rough performance for Green Bay's ground game, which gained just 55 yards on 14 carries. Williams got two totes, and the wide receiver ended up atop the team's rushing leaderboard with 18 yards, ahead of RBs Kaleb Johnson (13 yards on eight carries) and MarShawn Lloyd (10 yards on one carry). Williams has consistently seen minor work out of the backfield this season, logging at least one carry (but no more than three) in all but one of his six appearances. That gives a small boost to his fantasy outlook, but he's yet to reach 50 receiving yards in a game this season, so Williams is a very risky fantasy play. However, he'd probably get a boost in that regard if Christian Watson (concussion), who exited late in the first half Wednesday and didn't return, isn't able to suit up in Week 13 against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks rushed once for four yards and caught four of five targets for 22 yards in Wednesday's Thanksgiving Eve loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Brooks and Kaleb Johnson split the workload pretty evenly at running back for Green Bay, with the former logging 19 offensive snaps and the latter 24. Meanwhile, MarShawn Lloyd tallied just three snaps on offense. Whereas Johnson led the group with eight carries, Brooks was by far the most active in the passing game, tying for the overall team lead with both his five targets and four receptions. He had just four catches over five games coming into Wednesday, so it remains to be seen if the bump in work as a pass catcher continues for Brooks moving forward. The entire breakdown of the Packers backfield could shift in Week 13 against the Saints if Josh Jacobs (finger) is ready to return to action.

injuries.shortComment: Lloyd rushed once for 10 yards and caught his only target for six yards in Wednesday's Week 12 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: After logging double-digit snaps in each of his first nine games of the season, Lloyd totaled just three offensive snaps Wednesday. In that context, his production was relatively efficient -- in fact, his 10-yard run on his lone carry put him just behind starting running back Kaleb Johnson, who tallied just 13 rushing yards on eight totes. With that said, it's hard to see a path to meaningful fantasy production for Lloyd if he doesn't get more opportunities, and he could be phased out of the game plan altogether if Josh Jacobs (finger) is able to return for the Packers' Week 13 matchup in New Orleans on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson rushed eight times for 13 yards and brought in one of two targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.
injuries.longComment: As his final numbers indicate, Johnson couldn't find any running room but was very productive with his one catch. The 2025 third-round pick of the Steelers was in the lead role once again with Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive, but Johnson couldn't come close to matching the encouraging rushing production he'd managed over the previous two games (24 carries, 110 yards, one TD). Jacobs is expected back for the Packers' Week 13 road matchup against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6, a development that would relegate Johnson to his more customary reserve role.

injuries.shortComment: Love completed 17 of 29 passes for 198 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.
injuries.longComment: Love already had a daunting challenge coming in against a talented Rams secondary. It was made exponentially more difficult due to Christian Watson, to whom he threw his only touchdown pass of the night in the second quarter from six yards out, exiting the game for good late in the first half due to a possible concussion. The veteran signal-caller unsurprisingly scuffled throughout, and his two interceptions came in the second half while the game was still within reach for Green Bay. The game marked Love's first with multiple interceptions this season, as well as his third below 200 passing yards. Love will look to bounce back when the Packers return to action on the road against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Golden secured one of five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.
injuries.longComment: Golden saw Christian Watson exit for good late in the first half due to a possible concussion, but the former still couldn't capitalize on a night when Jordan Love threw for a modest 198 yards and tossed two interceptions. Golden's yardage total tied for his second-lowest figure of the season, while Wednesday marked his first game without multiple receptions. Golden will look to bounce back in a Week 13 road matchup against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Kraft brought in three of five targets for 24 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. He also lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Kraft finished second in receptions and tied for the team lead in targets for the Packers on a night when Jordan Love threw for under 200 yards. The veteran tight end saw Christian Watson exit the game twice with thigh and head injuries in the first half, the latter issue forcing his exit for the rest of the game. Kraft recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three contests in the process, but his first-quarter fumble led to a Rams field goal. Kraft carries an unremarkable 40-394-3 line heading into a Week 13 road matchup against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Sorrell (thumb) is questionable to return to Wednesday night's game against the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Prior to leaving, the linebacker recorded four tackles (two solo). Dani Dennis-Sutton and Brenton Cox will see an uptick in snaps off the edge for Green Bay.

injuries.shortComment: Watson (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Wednesday's game against the Rams.
injuries.longComment: The wideout hasn't cleared concussion checks and will miss the remainder of the Week 12 contest after he was injured at the end of the second quarter when Watson took a hit to the head from Kamren Kinchens. Look for J. Michael Sturdivant and Bo Melton to see increased snaps alongside Matthew Golden and Savion Williams with Watson sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Zeitler (triceps/ankle) is active for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Zeitler was unable to play against the Vikings in Week 10 due to triceps and ankle injuries, but the veteran offensive lineman has been cleared to play Wednesday. He should start at right guard while Travis Glover provides depth at the position.

injuries.shortComment: Glover (shoulder) is active for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Glover's practice reps were limited due to a shoulder injury, but the third-year pro was given the green light by medical staff to play Wednesday. He's started in five regular-season games, most recently in Week 10 against the Vikings, but he'll likely operate in a depth role at right guard behind starter Kevin Zeitler.

injuries.shortComment: Rhyan (ankle) is active for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Rhyan suffered a high ankle sprain against the Lions in Week 7, which sidelined him for the Packers' following three games. He's been cleared by medical staff to play Wednesday, and Rhyan will reclaim his starting spot at center while John Williams reverts to a depth role.

injuries.shortComment: Franklin (shin) is inactive for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Franklin drew the questionable tag for Wednesday's game following three consecutive limited practices. However, the veteran linebacker will end up missing a fifth consecutive game due to a hairline fracture in his shin that he suffered during a practice session in late October, so Ty'Ron Hopper will continue to operate in an elevated role on defense. Franklin's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injuries.shortComment: Jacobs (finger) is listed as inactive Wednesday at the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
injuries.longComment: Coming out of the Packers' Week 11 bye, head coach Matt LaFleur told Matt Schneidman of The Athletic on Saturday that he didn't expect Jacobs to play in Week 12, but he also gave the running back a "chance to prove" he can. Jacobs then was listed as limited on practice reports Sunday through Tuesday and tagged as questionable ahead of Wednesday's game. Such activity wasn't enough for Jacobs to get the all clear to suit up, meaning Green Bay's backfield will be manned by Kaleb Johnson, MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks for a second consecutive contest.

injuries.shortComment: Parsons (knee) is active for Wednesday's game at the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday that Parsons gained clearance to return to action, but first the Packers needed to activate him from the reserve/PUP list, which came to pass Tuesday. Parsons was listed as questionable ahead of Wednesday's matchup, and he's now ready for his first game since Dec. 14, 2025, when he tore the ACL and meniscus in his left knee. Tom Pelissero of Netflix reported Wednesday that Parsons will play approximately 50 percent of the defensive snaps in his season debut.

injuries.shortComment: Cisse (ribs) practiced fully Monday.
injuries.longComment: The Packers' rookie cornerback is ready to go for Wednesday's game against the Rams after he exited Week 10 early against the Vikings. Cisse has started all 10 games this season, recording 38 tackles (26 solo), including 1.5 sacks, and nine pass breakups, including an interception, on 83 percent of the defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.
injuries.longComment: LaFleur acknowledged that Musgrove is still in the process of rehabbing the neck injury he sustained during OTAs in June, and the Packers haven't yet prepared for the tight end to resume practicing. Barring dramatic progress in his recovery over the next month, Musgrave looks like he'll be sidelined for the final season of his rookie deal before hitting free agency in the spring.

injuries.shortComment: Williams logged eight tackles (two solo) and a pass defense during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
injuries.longComment: Williams played every single defensive snap in Week 10 and finished tied for the second-most tackles on the Packers behind Isaiah McDuffie (10). Williams has recorded at least eight stops in three of his last four outings and is up to 84 tackles (50 solo), including 1.0 sacks, eight pass defenses (including three interceptions) and a fumble recovery through 10 regular-season games. He is well on track to surpass 100 tackles for a second consecutive year.

injuries.shortComment: Schultz (illness) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Schultz wasn't listed on Wednesday's injury report, which indicates that the illness is a new concern for the veteran tight end. A full session Friday would likely be enough for him to avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens. Brevin Jordan (finger/foot), Foster Moreau and Marlin Klein would all be in line for larger roles on offense in the event that Schultz is not cleared to play in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Harrison (hamstring) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Harrison has missed the Texans' last two contests, but after a limited practice Wednesday, the wideout's full participation Thursday sets the stage for him to return to action Sunday against the Ravens. Given Harrison's modest production over three outings since arriving in a trade with the Cardinals, he profiles as a speculative fantasy lineup option in Week 12, with Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell and possibly Kayshon Boutte (hip, 'DNP' Thursday) also in Houston's WR mix.

injuries.shortComment: Boutte (hip) did not participate in Thursday's practice session.
injuries.longComment: Boutte has missed the first two practices of Week 12 prep while managing a hip injury that he sustained during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts in Week 11. If he doesn't practice Friday, then Boutte should be considered on the doubtful side of playing Sunday against the Ravens. Tank Dell, Marvin Harrison and Nikko Remigio would all be in line for larger roles in the Texans' offense in the event that Boutte doesn't play against Baltimore.

injuries.shortComment: Rankins (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Rankins sustained an ankle injury during Thursday's win over the Colts and did not return to the contest. The defensive tackle's absence from Wednesday's session suggests the injury was significant. Rankins will have Thursday and Friday's sessions to return to practice in time to avoid an injury designation, or to at least have a chance to suit up for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Hunter (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Hunter did not play in Thursday's win over the Colts due to his hamstring injury. The defensive end has still not returned to practice since sustaining the injury during Week 10 prep. If Hunter continues to miss practice, he will be in line to miss his third consecutive game due to the injury.

injuries.shortComment: Marks (concussion) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Marks didn't practice last week before being ruled out for this past Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts, but with some extra recovery time since then, the running back is trending toward a return to the lineup Sunday against the Ravens. To get there, however, he'll need to fully progress through the NFL's concussion protocol in the days leading up to the Texans' Week 12 contest.

injuries.shortComment: Stewart played 17 special-teams snaps in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: With the return of Reed Blankenship to the starting lineup, Stewart was relegated to special teams. The strong safety played 17 snaps but did not appear in the box score.

injuries.shortComment: To'oTo'o accumulated six tackles (four solo) in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: To'oTo'o played 100 percent of the Texans' defensive snaps for the second straight week. The linebacker was on the field for all 48 plays, logging four solo tackles in the effort.

injuries.shortComment: Anderson logged five tackles (two solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Anderson extended his NFL sacks lead to 11.5 in Thursday's contest. The pass rusher is amassing another strong season to contend for Defensive Player of the Year. Anderson finished 2025 with 12.0 sacks and is set to surpass that personal record this season.

injuries.shortComment: Moreau brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Moreau's 30 offensive snaps were second among Texans tight ends behind Dalton Schultz's 34, yet it was Marlin Klein who led the position group with four catches (on as many targets) for 24 yards, including a 13-yard touchdown pass from C.J. Stroud late in the third quarter. Moreau is up to a 12-80-3 receiving line on 15 targets through 10 regular-season games and has caught one pass or zero in five of those contests. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal unless Schultz were to miss time.

injuries.shortComment: Fairbairn made his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Fairbairn's only field goal of the night was a 27-yarder with 15 seconds remaining in the first half. The kicker is 20-for-21 on field-goal attempts and 27-for-27 on PATs over 10 regular-season games so far in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Demercado rushed five times for 33 yards and caught both of his targets for minus-four yards in Thursday night's 26-3 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: With Woody Marks (concussion) inactive, Demercado played the complementary role behind lead back David Montgomery, who rushed 26 times for 107 yards in his return from a multi-week groin injury. Demercado was picked up off waivers from Dallas last month.

injuries.shortComment: Hutchinson caught two of three targets for 13 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Hutchinson played 54 of 66 offensive snaps, second at wide receiver on the team behind Nico Collins' 59, and the former has been operating as the Texans' WR2 in terms of playing time for the last several weeks. By not scoring a touchdown Thursday night, Hutchinson snapped his personal three-game touchdown streak. For the season, he has 30 catches for 358 yards and three scores on 57 targets. He's on pace to set new career highs across the board.

injuries.shortComment: Klein secured all four targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Klein surprisingly outpaced veteran position mates Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau on the night, and the rookie second-round pick, whose only other career reception coming in was a 16-yard grab in Week 1, added his first career touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the third quarter. Given Klein had been a complete non-factor coming into the night, it's difficult to predict whether Thursday's production will have any carryover to a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Dell secured three of four targets for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The speedy wideout finished tied for second in receptions for the Texans on a night when C.J. Stroud recorded completions to nine different targets overall. Dell has played an effective complementary role since making his return from a gruesome 2024 knee injury in Week 7, as he now has an 11-196-1 line and four catches of 20-plus yards across 18 targets heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Facing a Colts defense down both Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee), Collins looked primed for a big night early when he recorded a 42-yard touchdown grab to cap off Houston's second possession. However, C.J. Stroud proceeded to spread the ball around to nine different targets overall, leading to Collins tying his second-lowest reception tally and posting his third-lowest yardage total of the season. However, the star wideout did extend his touchdown streak to three games, and he'll next take aim at what has been an inconsistent Ravens secondary in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29. However, if Marks is able to clear concussion protocol ahead of that contest, Montgomery will see his touch count take a hit.

injuries.shortComment: Rutledge (stinger) was deemed questionable to return near the end of Thursday's 26-3 win against Indianapolis and didn't end up re-entering the game.
injuries.longComment: The Texans announced Rutledge's injury in the waning moments of the contest, but he had been in the medical tent well before that time. Febechi Nwaiwu took over at left guard following Rutledge's departure. With Houston not set to play again until Sunday, Nov. 29, against Baltimore, Rutledge will look to recover from the stinger in time to suit up.

injuries.shortComment: Ogletree (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Ogletree was held out of Wednesday's practice due to a knee injury, but his full session Thursday puts the fifth-year tight end on track to play against the Giants on Sunday. Ogletree has a 4-21-0 receiving line on seven targets through 11 regular-season games and has not been targeted in three of his last four outings.

injuries.shortComment: Curry underwent surgery to repair a ligament tear in his wrist earlier this week and will be sidelined for the rest of the 2026 season, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.
injuries.longComment: Curry was placed on the Colts' injured reserve Tuesday, and head coach Shane Steichen informed reporters Wednesday that the rookie sixth-rounder's wrist injury was severe enough for him to require season-ending surgery. Curry will end his first NFL campaign with 26 tackles (14 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and two fumble recoveries across 11 regular-season games. His absence means Carl Lawson, Jaylahn Tuimoloau and George Gumbs are all in line for more rotational snaps at defensive end.

injuries.shortComment: The Colts designated Taylor-Britt (groin) to return from injured reserve Wednesday, Abby Halpin of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Taylor-Britt was a full participant in Wednesday's practice in what was his first session since suffering a groin injury in Week 7 against the Vikings. Even if he strings together two more full sessions, Taylor-Britt would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Sunday's game against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Gardner (calf) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Gardner did not play in the Colts' Week 11 loss to the Texans due to a calf injury. The cornerback has recovered since Thursday's contest and is all set to practice in full throughout Week 12 prep. Gardner's fellow starting cornerback Charvarius Ward (knee) also missed Week 11 and was a limited participant Wednesday, meaning the Colts could get both corners back for Sunday against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Ward (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Ward missed the Colts' Week 11 game against the Texans due to a knee injury he sustained in Week 10. The cornerback's upgrade to limited participation to start Week 12 prep is a good sign, but he will need to continue logging active sessions for a chance to suit up for Sunday's game against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: When addressing the press Wednesday, Pierce (heel) noted that the offseason procedure he underwent this past March was done because he was dealing with heel pain that impacted his Achilles, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.
injuries.longComment: Additionally, Pierce acknowledged that playing in Week 1 was a bit lofty, per Bowen, with the WR saying Wednesday that he was still managing some pain at that stage. In any case, Pierce indicated that he's confident that his current recovery plan will lead to a full return to health. When that will be remains to be seen, but the 2022 second-rounder is still on IR ahead of Week 12, with the Colts presumably not planning to rush him back given the team's 3-8 record in a campaign that's been marked by the team moving several key players ahead of the trade deadline.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor will be joined in the backfield in Sunday's game against the Giants by Anthony Richardson, who was named the Colts' new starting quarterback after Daniel Jones was cut Friday, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.
injuries.longComment: Taylor is slated to take his first extended snaps alongside Richardson since the 2024 season, when the two started together 10 times. The threat that Richardson presented to defenses as a runner seemed to aid Taylor's own effectiveness, as the running back averaged 4.8 yards per carry and scored eight touchdowns over that 10-game stretch. Now two years later, the Colts have a much less formidable offensive line in place and few established pass-catching weapons that defenses need to hone in on, so Taylor will likely be hard-pressed to match the lofty production he previously achieved with Richardson under center. Additionally, the 3-8 Colts may be cognizant of not overworking Taylor amid a losing season, though the loss of top backup Seth McGowan (hamstring) for at least Week 12 may result in Taylor seeing a slight uptick in opportunities after he played fewer than 70 percent of snaps in each of the last five games and averaged 16.6 touches in those contests.

injuries.shortComment: Indianapolis signed Lawson from its practice squad to its 53-man roster Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: In a corresponding transaction, the Colts placed rookie sixth-round defensive end Caden Curry on injured reserve. In his one appearance so far this season back in Week 8 at Jacksonville, Lawson played just eight defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: The Colts signed Buechele off the Bills' practice squad Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: Buechele takes the QB No. 3 spot in Indy behind Anthony Richardson and Riley Leonard. The 28-year-old spent the previous 11 weeks of the NFL season with Buffalo, splitting time on the active roster and practice squad.

injuries.shortComment: Giddens will likely move up to the No. 2 RB role for the Colts in the short term, as Seth McGowan is expected to miss time due to a hamstring injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that McGowan "will miss some time" but didn't specify how long the absence may be. For however long McGowan is sidelined, Giddens figures to serve as Jonathan Taylor's backup at running back. Giddens has shown some flashes this season in limited playing time, amassing 48 yards on seven carries (6.9 YPC) and catching his only target for 11 yards over three games.

injuries.shortComment: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: McGowan went down with the injury while returning a kickoff in the first half of the Week 11 loss. The rookie seventh-round pick had been solidified as the top backup to starting running back Jonathan Taylor, but DJ Giddens now is positioned to serve as Taylor's main understudy for however long McGowan is sidelined. McGowan can be safely ruled out for the Week 12 game against the Giants, though a Week 13 bye could help the 25-year-old back avoid additional absences beyond that.

injuries.shortComment: Brown went without a target while playing eight of the Colts' 50 offensive snaps in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: For the second week in a row, Brown ended up seeing more snaps on special teams (11) than offense. Through four games with Indianapolis, Brown has drawn just one target, which he turned into a seven-yard reception during a Week 6 loss to the Titans.

injuries.shortComment: Boettcher recorded six tackles (three solo) during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Boettcher finished Thursday's game tied for the fourth-most tackles on the Colts. The rookie fourth-rounder has started in each of Indianapolis' last three games, which has lined up with the absence of Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee, IR). Boettcher is up to 50 tackles (16 solo) through 11 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Adebawore finished Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with seven tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks.
injuries.longComment: Adebawore recorded his fifth sack of the season early in the third quarter, when he took down C.J. Stroud for a seven-yard loss. Adebawore has already set a career-high in sacks through 11 regular-season games and has accumulated 31 tackles (15 solo), one defense and a scoop-and-score in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Haulcy logged nine tackles (four solo) and an interception during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The rookie third-rounder recorded the first interception of his career in the first quarter, when a pass from C.J. Stroud intended for Nico Collins bounced off Haulcy's helmet, off the hands of Cam Bynum and into Haulcy's arms. The LSU product is up to 53 tackles (30 solo) and three pass defenses through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Allen posted 16 tackles (seven solo) during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: It was a busy night for the rookie second-rounder, who finished with a career-high in stops while logging double-digit tackles for the third time this season. Allen has 45 total tackles over his last four outings, and most of that extra playing time has come in the absence of Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee, IR).

injuries.shortComment: Watkins caught one of his three targets for 26 yards during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Watkins played just five offensive snaps for the Colts in Thursday night's game. Despite playing only 10 percent of the offensive snaps, Watkins totaled the third-highest yardage by Colts pass catchers on the night with his 26-yard grab. The reserve wide receiver could see an expanded role down the stretch as the Colts experiment with starting quarterback Anthony Richardson in what is all but a lost season.

injuries.shortComment: Dulin caught two of his four targets for 30 yards and assisted on two tackles on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Dulin played 22 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in the contest. The No. 4 wide receiver saw plenty of attention, catching 50 percent of his targets to accumulate the second-highest receiving yardage for the Colts, behind Anthony Gould's 48 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Burks was targeted three times for zero catches, had one kick return for 10 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Burks was the No. 2 wide receiver for the Colts in the contest. Despite being targeted three times, the wide receiver could not haul in any passes from since-cut quarterback Daniel Jones. Burks played 32 offensive snaps and two special-teams snaps in the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Striggow (concussion) was listed as a full participant during Jacksonville's practice estimate Thursday, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injuries.longComment: Striggow will be good to go for Sunday's matchup against the Titans after clearing the league's concussion protocol. The 24-year-old has compiled 13 tackles (nine solo), including 1.0 sacks, across nine games this season while playing on both defense and special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Tuten (ankle/foot) didn't practice Thursday, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injuries.longComment: Back-to-back 'DNPs' Wednesday and Thursday cloud Tuten's status for Sunday's game against the Titans, with the running back's Friday practice participation level looming large in terms of his Week 12 availability. If Tuten isn't active versus Tennessee, Chris Rodriguez will be in line for an increased workload in the Jacksonville backfield, with LeQuint Allen and Ameer Abdullah also in the mix.

injuries.shortComment: Washington (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injuries.longComment: Washington wasn't on Wednesday's injury report, so his addition to it a day later is certainly of note. It remains to be seen if the WR, who is coming off consecutive big games for the Jaguars, is managing a shoulder issue stemming from Week 11 action or was hurt in Thursday's practice. Friday's report will reveal both Washington's participation level to close the week, as well as his game status for a 1:00 p.m. ET matchup versus the Titans on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: The Jaguars designated Mekari (back) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Mekari now has a 21-day window for the Jaguars to return him to the active roster. The right guard returned to practice as a limited participant. If Mekari can upgrade to a full participant by Friday's session, there is a chance he could be activated for Sunday's game against the Titans. The Jaguars could just as easily take it slow with the veteran offensive lineman to ensure he is healthy and ready for his return to the field, so Ezra Cleveland may be in line for another start at right guard.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (chest) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Jones suffered a chest injury during the first half of the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants in Week 12 and did not return. However, his full session Wednesday indicates that Jones' injury isn't a severe one and puts him on track to play in Sunday's AFC South tilt against the Titans. Jones has 26 tackles (19 solo) and eight pass defenses (including an interception) across 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Meyers was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury.
injuries.longComment: Dating back to Week 8, Meyers has been listed on Jaguars injury reports with the ankle issue, but it hasn't stopped him from being available on game days. His limitations Wednesday were most likely maintenance-related after he turned in one his best performances of 2026 in this past Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. Meyers played 83 percent of the offensive snaps in the loss, finishing with four catches for a season-high 85 yards on 10 targets.
