injuries.shortComment: Oluokun compiled nine tackles (seven solo) during Jacksonville's loss to the Giants on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Oluokun had a solid outing despite the loss, logging a team-high nine tackles while playing every defensive snap. The 2018 sixth-round pick has now totaled 77 tackles (48 solo), including 2.0 sacks, two interceptions and a forced fumble across 10 games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Allen caught one pass for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Allen played 14 offensive snaps behind Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez, and Tuten ended up aggravating his ankle issue in the defeat. If Tuten needs to miss time, Allen could see elevated snaps behind Rodriguez, though Ameer Abdullah also is an option for the Jaguars out of the backfield. Ultimately, Allen is much likelier than not to remain irrelevant in fantasy.

injuries.shortComment: Cameron caught three of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss against the Giants. He also returned two kickoffs for a total of 40 yards.
injuries.longComment: Despite being on the field for only 25 of the Jaguars' 68 offensive snaps in Week 11, Cameron drew a career-high seven targets. He wasn't terribly efficient on those targets, but neither was Jacksonville's offense as a whole Sunday. He'll be lining up against a much softer pass defense in a Week 12 tilt versus the Titans.

injuries.shortComment: Hunter caught his lone target for three yards, added a nine-yard carry and logged six tackles (four solo) during the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: As has been the case for most of the 2026 season, Hunter spent the majority of his time on the field playing defense, and his six tackles were fourth most on the Jaguars. He had a quiet day offensively, and the second-year pro is up to a 10-94-1 line on 11 targets through 10 regular-season games. On the defensive side of the ball, Hunter is up to 42 tackles (28 solo) and seven pass defenses (including three interceptions).

injuries.shortComment: Morris went without a target while logging 11 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
injuries.longComment: For the first time since Week 3, Morris earned more playing time on offense than rookie Tanner Koziol (four snaps), who had previously been serving as the Jaguars' No. 3 tight end. Koziol offers more of a pass-catching threat at the position, but Morris is the superior blocker and also has a more integral role on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Koziol went without a target while playing four of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
injuries.longComment: The rookie fifth-round pick saw his streak of three straight games with a reception come to an end and also had his snap count decline for the fourth week in a row. Koziol ranked fourth in playing time among Jacksonville tight ends, marking the first time since Week 3 that he had played behind Quintin Morris (11 snaps Sunday).

injuries.shortComment: Boerkircher didn't draw a target while playing 22 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Though quarterback Trevor Lawrence dropped back a season-high 50 times on the day and targeted nine different players, Boerkircher wasn't able to earn a look in the passing game. The second-round rookie out of Texas A&M is regarded mainly as a run-blocking specialist, but he had carved out a minor role in the passing attack with at least one reception in each of Jacksonville's previous six contests.

injuries.shortComment: Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Strange was able to notch at least three catches for the first time since Week 6, but he still finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the second straight week and third time overall this year. The tight end has now reeled in 35 of 43 targets for 381 yards and two touchdowns over 10 contests during the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. He added one catch for 13 yards on one target.
injuries.longComment: With the Jaguars chasing points and playing from behind most of the afternoon, Bhayshul Tuten and Rodrgiuez combined for just 14 carries, while Trevor Lawrence dropped back to pass 50 times. Rodriguez's catch was just his fifth of the season, and he's handled single-digit carries in eight of 10 contests. He's merely an insurance policy behind Tuten in fantasy.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Thomas' three targets were a distant fourth on the team, as Parker Washington (17), Jakobi Meyers (10) and Josh Cameron (seven) combined to see a combined 34 looks on Trevor Lawrence's 47 pass attempts. Thomas ran 32 routes, 14 more than Cameron as the Jaguars' nominal WR3, but the former hasn't been seeing meaningful target volume for months. After drawing nine targets in Week 2, Thomas has averaged 2.1 targets per game over his last eight contests. He's well off the fantasy radar while Washington and Meyers are healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Downs secured one of four targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: After recording consecutive four-catch tallies following his trade from the Colts, Downs' production saw a downturn Thursday in a game where both air attacks performed below their usual levels. The talented receiver did make good use of his one reception, and Downs should be busier in a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday night where weather shouldn't be a factor.

injuries.shortComment: Worthy didn't corral any of his three targets during Thursday's 13-10 loss at Buffalo.
injuries.longComment: Since Josh Downs arrived via trade from Indianapolis at the deadline, Rashee Rice is leading all Chiefs wide receivers in targets with 17 over the last three contests, followed by Downs' 14, Worthy's 10, Cyrus Allen's nine, Jalen Royals' (ankle) two and Andrew Armstrong's two. Worthy's average number of targets has reduced from 5.9 per game pre-Downs to 3.3 since the addition to the position group, and the former has just a 2-38-1 line during that span. As a result, Worthy is difficult to trust as Kansas City prepares to face the Rams on the road next Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Rice brought in two of five targets for 19 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Rice's production was part of the collateral damage of a night that was unconducive for offense, as the veteran receiver tied his lowest reception and receiving yardage totals of the season for a non-injury-shortened game. Rice came in riding a solid four-game stretch where he'd generated a 23-237-1 line on 27 targets, and he'll look to return to that level of production during a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Andy Reid said Smith sustained an ankle sprain during Thursday's 13-10 loss in Buffalo, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Smith was injured in the fourth quarter of Week 12 action, but the Chiefs never announced the reason for him hitting the sideline until Reid spoke to the media afterward. If the severity of Smith's issue is enough to require an absence or more time off, Hunter Nourzad is the likely candidate to man right guard for Kansas City.

injuries.shortComment: Mahomes completed 16 of 29 passes for 174 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed three times for two yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. He also fumbled twice but recovered on each occasion.
injuries.longComment: Like Josh Allen, Mahomes didn't come close to putting up his typical caliber of production in the poor weather conditions Thursday, although the latter was at least relatively efficient compared to his opposite number. However, Mahomes failed to throw at least one touchdown pass for the first time in five games, and his yardage total was his second-lowest of the campaign. Mahomes will look to bounce back in what will be an appreciably better environment for offense during a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Andy Reid said Royals suffered a sprained ankle during Thursday's 13-10 loss in Buffalo, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Royals left the game in the third quarter and was ruled out not long afterward due to an ankle injury. The severity of the sprain will determine if Royals is in danger of missing any time. If that comes to pass for Royals, Andrew Armstrong likely will be on track for a few more offensive snaps behind Rashee Rice, Josh Downs, Xavier Worthy and Cyrus Allen.

injuries.shortComment: Kelce brought in four of seven targets for 71 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Kelce, who shook off a hard hit to his lower back late in the first half, ended up posting a game-high receiving yardage total with the help of a game-long 24-yard grab that he made late in the first half, and he also tied for the team lead in receptions. The star tight end did have a couple of missed connections with Patrick Mahomes on fourth-quarter drives, however, plays that could have had an impact on the outcome of such a close game. Kelce has exceeded 65 receiving yards in four of the last five games heading into a Week 13 road showdown against the Rams next Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson rushed 17 times for 72 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 24 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Making a third straight start in place of Kenneth Walker (groin), Johnson put together another useful all-around performance that included his third rushing touchdown of the season on a one-yard run early in the third quarter. Johnson also recorded at least four catches for the third consecutive game, and he's now accumulated 410 scrimmage yards and four total TDs over his three starts. Walker is likely to be back for next Thursday's Week 13 road showdown against the Rams, but Johnson is likely to retain a solid complementary role even when his star teammate is back on the field.

injuries.shortComment: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Nussmeier has yet to appear in a game this season but will once again serve as the team's emergency quarterback. The rookie seventh-round pick will only be able to play against Buffalo if both Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Woods (neck) is active for Thursday's game against the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Woods drew the questionable tag for Thanksgiving Day, and the rookie first-rounder has been cleared by medical staff to return from a three-game absence due to a neck injury. In seven regular-season games prior to the injury, Woods accumulated 13 tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, and one pass defense while operating in a rotational role on the Chiefs' interior defensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Gray (ribs) is active for Thursday's game against the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Gray injured his ribs against the Cardinals on Sunday, and after logging full practices Tuesday and Wednesday, the sixth-year tight end has been cleared by medical staff to play on Thanksgiving Day. He has a 19-211-1 receiving line on 25 targets through 10 regular-season games while operating as the Chiefs' TE2 behind Travis Kelce.

injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs elevated FitzPatrick from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Thursday's game against the Bills, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injuries.longComment: FitzPatrick signed with the Chiefs' practice squad Nov. 17, and he'll now be available to make his 2026 regular-season debut to provide depth at tight end in the event that Noah Gray (ribs) cannot play Thursday. FitzPatrick appeared in 15 regular-season games for the Packers in 2025 and posted a 12-72-1 receiving line on 15 targets.

injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs elevated Carter from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Thursday's game against the Bills, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injuries.longComment: It's the third and final time Carter is eligible to be elevated from the practice squad, so he would need to be signed to the 53-man roster in order to suit up for the Chiefs beyond Week 12. With Kenneth Walker (groin) out for a third consecutive game, Carter will operate as Kansas City's RB3 behind Emmett Johnson and Jaydn Ott.

injuries.shortComment: Norman-Lott (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Despite logging full participation sessions in Week 12 prep, Norman-Lott will not suit up for Thursday night's contest. The Chiefs activated the defensive tackle from the reserve/PUP list Nov. 18, but he is not quite ready to return to the field.

injuries.shortComment: Moore (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Moore will miss his third consecutive game with an ankle injury. Joshua Ezeudu will once again be called upon to start at right tackle for the Chiefs' offense.

injuries.shortComment: The Chiefs placed VanSumeren (knee) on the reserve/injured list Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: VanSumeren didn't practice Tuesday due to a sprained knee that will now keep him out for at least the next four weeks, according to Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site. In six regular-season games in 2026, the fourth-year pro played a majority of his reps on special teams, with just six of 104 total snaps coming on offense.

injuries.shortComment: Tranquill recorded eight total tackles (three solo) during Sunday's 34-7 win against the Cardinals.
injuries.longComment: Tranquill led the team in stops in Week 11, notching at least eight tackles for the third straight week. He was able to put together an impressive performance while playing a season-low 39 defensive snaps as a result of the team's blowout victory. Tranquill has now compiled 83 total tackles (42 solo), two passes defensed and a fumble recovery over the team's first 10 games of the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Bolton recorded five total tackles (two solo) and a pass defensed during Sunday's 34-7 win over Arizona.
injuries.longComment: Bolton was on the field for a season-low 38 defensive snaps as Kansas City dominated the Cardinals in Week 11, and as a result, he notched his fewest takedowns since Week 1. The linebacker has now registered 94 total tackles (46 solo), three passes defensed and two forced fumbles over 10 contests to open the 2026 season.

injuries.shortComment: Karlaftis recorded four total tackles (three solo), including 2.5 sacks, and a forced fumble during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
injuries.longComment: Karlaftis was a man on a mission in Week 11, getting to Cardinals quarterback Josh Johnson on three separate occasions. The defensive lineman combined with teammate Chris Jones to sack Johnson in the second quarter before securing full sacks of the quarterback on back-to-back plays in the third quarter. Karlaftis is now up to 38 total tackles (20 solo), including 8.0 sacks, while also adding a career-high 10 passes defensed, one of which is an interception, and two forced fumbles over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Allen caught two of four targets for 41 yards during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
injuries.longComment: Allen was able to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after having done so only twice in the team's first eight games of the year. The wide receiver played 16 offensive snaps which ranked sixth at his position behind Xavier Worthy (47), Rashee Rice (32), Jalen Royals (24), Andrew Armstrong (20) and Josh Downs (17). As a result of the depth of the WR room in Kansas City, Allen will remain a hard fantasy option to trust Thursday versus the Bills.

injuries.shortComment: Ott logged five rushing attempts for 12 yards and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Ott logged 12 offensive snaps and eight special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The running back saw a few carries behind Emmett Johnson due to the absence of Kenneth Walker (groin). With Walker likely returning for Thursday night's game against the Bills, Ott may not see the field on offense in that contest.

injuries.shortComment: Hemingway (upper body) was listed as a non-participant in Las Vegas' practice estimate Thursday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Hemingway is still battling the shoulder injury that sidelined him for the Week 11 loss to Denver. The 25-year-old will likely need to be upgraded to a full participant in Friday's practice in order to avoid an injury designation for Sunday's matchup against the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Bowers (ankle) remained a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: The star tight end, who was inactive this past Sunday against the Broncos, now has strung together four straight limited practices, which bodes well for his chances of being back for this weekend's game against the Browns. Friday's final injury report will determine whether Bowers carries an injury designation for the contest or is fully cleared for Week 12 action.

injuries.shortComment: Butler (concussion) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Butler enterted the NFL's concussion protocol after being ruled out for the remainder of the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos. The defensive tackle will need to be cleared by an independent neurologist to return to full-contact practice.

injuries.shortComment: Pegues (forearm) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Pegues exited the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos late in the fourth quarter and did not return to the contest. The defensive tackle's full participation and injury clearance in the first prep session of Week 12 imply Pegues did not return to the Week 11 loss because he exited late, when the game was out of reach.

injuries.shortComment: The Raiders designated Johnson (neck) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Johnson was a full participant in Wednesday's practice in what was his first on-field action since being placed on injured reserve in late October due to a neck injury. His ability to practice in full is an encouraging sign, but Johnson would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Sunday's game against the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Young (stinger) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Young was diagnosed with a stinger in the first half of the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos and did not return. However, his ability to practice in full Wednesday indicates that the fifth-year wide receiver will be available for Sunday's road game against the Browns. Young has mostly operated on special teams this season and has not been targeted in the passing game since Week 4 against the Chiefs.

injuries.shortComment: Chinn recorded seven total tackles (five solo) during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Chinn was on the field for all 73 of the team's defensive snaps, and as a result, he was able to notch at least seven stops for the seventh straight game. The safety has now registered 79 total tackles (52 solo), including 1.0 sacks, while also adding an interception, two forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries over 11 contests this season.

injuries.shortComment: Walker recorded 11 tackles (seven solo) in Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: It was Walker's fourth game this season with double-digit tackles, and he's now up to 91 tackles (39 solo), including 2.0 sacks, and a pair of fumble recoveries across 11 games this season. He's taken a bit of a back seat to Nakobe Dean in the tackles department for Las Vegas, as Dean leads the NFL with his 119 total tackles.

injuries.shortComment: Dean recorded 12 tackles (six solo), including 1.0 sacks, and a pass breakup in Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: The linebacker has at least a dozen tackles in seven of 10 games this season and leads the NFL with 119 tackles (56 solo). He's also recorded three pass breakups, including one interception, three forced fumbles and a fumble recovery while playing 100 percent of the Raiders' defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas caught his lone target for a 19-yard touchdown during the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Thomas had the opportunity to step into the TE2 role behind Michael Mayer on Sunday due to the absence of Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps). Thomas' 35 offensive snaps were his most of the season, and he made his lone target from Fernando Mendoza count, with the duo connecting on a 19-yard touchdown pass late in the third quarter to tie the game up at 17-17. Thomas has seven catches on as many targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns through 11 regular-season games, although he would revert to being the No. 3 tight end in Week 12 against the Browns on Nov. 29 if Bowers is cleared to return for that contest.

injuries.shortComment: Gay made his lone field-goal attempt and all three of his extra-point tries during the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Gay has attempted only one field goal in three of his last four outings, and his lone try Sunday was a chip shot from 28 yards out. He's 22-for-24 on field-goal attempts through 11 regular-season games, and he's ranked fifth in the NFL in made field goals. The Raiders will hit the road for Week 12 against the Browns on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Nailor caught one of five targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Nailor caught one pass for the second straight week, and he has exceeded 20 receiving yards only one time since Week 1. The wide receiver was unable to capitalize on the absence of Brock Bowers (ankle) in Week 11, and Nailor figures to remain an unattractive fantasy option in Week 12 against the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Tucker finished with a team-high 10 targets, but he was unable to get on the same page with quarterback Fernando Mendoza for the majority of the game. Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.

injuries.shortComment: Washington turned nine carries into 42 yards during Sunday's 38-24 defeat in Denver.
injuries.longComment: With only seven targets and four catches through 11 games to begin his career, Washington requires volume on the ground to produce, which is difficult to come by in a backfield led by Ashton Jeanty. And Jeanty was the engine of the Raiders offense Sunday, racking up 16 touches for 169 yards from scrimmage and one receiving TD. A rookie fourth-rounder, Washington is averaging just 3.9 yards per carry and has scored only one touchdown ahead of next Sunday's road matchup with the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Mayer posted one catch (on four targets) for four yards during Sunday's 38-24 defeat at Denver.
injuries.longComment: Mayer missed out on a prime opportunity with top TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) inactive in Week 11. When Bowers was out in Weeks 1 and 2 as he recovered from a meniscus trim in his left knee, Mayer went for a combined 9-55-0 line on 11 targets in those contests, but the latter also missed a stretch in the fourth quarter this Sunday due to a back injury. Bowers' status will be worth monitoring this week, as an absence from him next Sunday in Cleveland will set up Mayer for another key chance to produce.

injuries.shortComment: Mendoza was 18-for-37 passing for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and had four carries for 22 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss in Denver.
injuries.longComment: After throwing for no touchdowns or interceptions in his first NFL start last Sunday against the Seahawks, Mendoza recorded the first scoring strike of his career on a 68-yard catch and run via RB Ashton Jeanty in Week 11. Mendoza also hooked up with Ian Thomas (19 yards) and Jack Bech (seven yards) for his other two TDs, but he followed up a 58.6 completion percentage in Week 10 with more misfires (19) than connections (18) this Sunday. Mendoza's next chance for game action is next Sunday at Cleveland.

injuries.shortComment: Jeanty tallied 11 carries for 79 yards and gathered in five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 loss at Denver.
injuries.longComment: Jeanty's 169 yards from scrimmage amounted to the second-highest single-game total of his career after going for 188 such yards against the Texans in Week 16 of last season. His performance was fueled by a 68-yard catch and run for a touchdown and a 46-yard rush, the latter of which marked his first of 20-plus yards on the campaign. Jeanty also broke a streak of four straight contests falling short of 10 carries, but considering No. 2 RB Mike Washington also earned nine runs in Week 11, the Raiders backfield remains a committee ahead of next Sunday's outing at Cleveland.

injuries.shortComment: Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Bech finished second on the team in targets behind fellow wideout Tre Tucker (10), and he was able to reel in a seven-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Fernando Mendoza in the fourth quarter. The score was Bech's first since Week 1, and his 88 receiving yards bested his previous season total of 67 yards entering Week 11. The wide receiver appears to have great chemistry with Mendoza, garnering 16 targets over the quarterback's first two career starts.

injuries.shortComment: Keenan (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's contest against Denver.
injuries.longComment: Keenan went down with a knee injury in the first half, and he will now officially be sidelined for the rest of Week 11. With Adam Butler (concussion) also done for the day, JJ Pegues will handle the bulk of the workload at defensive tackle versus the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Thornton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's Week 11 tilt against Denver.
injuries.longComment: Thornton is dealing with a back injury, but he wasn't listed on Las Vegas' practice report during Week 11 prep. As such, it appears the second-year wideout is a healthy scratch Sunday. Tre Tucker, Jalen Nailor, Jack Bech, Dareke Young and Cody White will make up the Raiders' WR corps.

injuries.shortComment: Fatukasi (toe) is active against the Broncos on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fatukasi was tagged as questionable due to a toe injury, although he ended Week 11 prep with a full practice Friday, and he's now been cleared by medical staff to play Sunday. The veteran defensive lineman has 16 tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks, one pass defense and one forced fumble through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Njoku (shoulder) was listed as a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Njoku also was deemed a 'DNP' on Wednesday, so the tight end presumably will need to practice Friday, in some capacity, in order to avoid an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Patriots. If Njoku ends up sidelined this weekend, Charlie Kolar and Oronde Gadsden will be in line to lead the Chargers' Week 12 TE corps.

injuries.shortComment: Herbert (concussion) was officially deemed a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Herbert, who landed in the NFL's concussion protocol in the wake of this past Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, didn't practice Wednesday, either. He thus is looking iffy, at best, for this weekend's game against the Patriots, especially given the Chargers' 1-9 record. If Herbert is inactive versus New England, DJ Uiagalelei would be in line to start at QB in his place, with Jake Browning available to back him up.

injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Leonard (groin) on injured reserve Thursday.
injuries.longComment: It's not clear when Leonard was injured, as he logged a season-high 70 percent defensive snap share against the Jets last Sunday. Regardless, he's now required to miss at least four games while on IR. Avery Smith and Isas Waxter may get more opportunities in the secondary during Leonard's absence.

injuries.shortComment: The Chargers signed Browning to their active roster Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Browning joined Los Angeles' practice squad Oct. 13 and had been there since before being promoted to the active roster Thursday. The move could be a bad sign for starting QB Justin Herbert, who is in concussion protocol and could  miss Sunday's clash against New England. Should Herbert miss that game, rookie DJ Uiagalelei would likely log his first NFL start, with Browning working as his backup.

injuries.shortComment: Mesidor (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: The rookie first-rounder is working through an ankle injury that he picked up during the first half of the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 12. Mesidor has two more opportunities to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's contest against the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Tuipulotu (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Tuipulotu appears to have sustained his ankle injury in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets. The outside linebacker will need to upgrade his practice participation in Thursday or Friday's session for a chance to suit up for Sunday's contest against the Patriots. If the 24-year-old must miss the game, Akheem Mesidor (ankle) or Caleb Murphy will likely start opposite Khalil Mack.

injuries.shortComment: Thompson (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Thompson has not played since the Chargers' Week 2 game with the Raiders. The wide receiver initially dealt with a quadriceps injury before sustaining a hamstring injury while still recovering. Thompson's long string of DNPs continues into Week 12 prep, and it appears there may be no end in sight.

injuries.shortComment: Tomlinson (knee) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Tomlinson likely sustained his knee injury in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets. The defensive tackle will likely need to return to practice by Friday's session for a chance to suit up for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Still (ankle) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Still did not play in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets due to an ankle injury he sustained in Friday's practice. The cornerback remains sidelined with the issue, leaving Deane Leonard and Genesis Smith as the early options at slot cornerback for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Henley (knee) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Henley did not play in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets due to his knee injury. The linebacker has not practiced since sustaining the injury after Week 10. If Henley cannot suit up for Sunday's game, Marlowe Wax and Troy Dye will likely see increased snap shares at inside linebacker next to Del'Shawn Phillips.

injuries.shortComment: Mitchell (knee) did not practice Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: The running back was injured in last Sunday's loss to the Jets. If Mitchell needs to miss time, it would likely turn this frustrating three-way committee backfield into a more traditional two-man affair, with Omarion Hampton handling early-down work and Kimani Vidal spelling him in passing situations.

injuries.shortComment: Gadsden went without a target while taking the field for 23 of the Chargers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Gadsden ranked third in snaps among Chargers tight ends, finishing only slightly behind Charlie Kolar (30) and David Njoku (25). Despite arguably being the most talented pass catcher of the trio, Gadsden was the only one of the three who failed to draw a target in Week 11. The 2025 fifth-round pick has endured a disappointing sophomore campaign, having thus far put together a 20-179-1 receiving line on 30 targets over 10 games while topping 40 receiving yards on just one occasion.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: Molden recorded eight tackles (four solo) in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: The safety has finished with five or more stops in seven of the eight games he's played in this season. Molden has 44 tackles (25 solo), a pass breakup and a fumble recovery in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Phillips finished with four tackles (two solo) in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: The linebacker recorded at least four stops for the fourth game in a row and the ninth time in 10 games this season. Phillips has 53 tackles (23 solo) and an interception on the year.

injuries.shortComment: Kolar brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Kolar was cleared to play Sunday after progressing through the league's concussion protocol, and his 30 offensive snaps were ahead of fellow tight ends David Njoku (25) and Oronde Gadsden (23). Kolar's eight-yard catch midway through the first quarter was the only pass that the fifth-year pro saw from Justin Herbert, but no Chargers pass catcher saw more than five targets other then Ladd McConkey (eight). Kolar has a 16-153-0 line on 24 targets through eight regular-season games heading into Week 12 against the Patriots on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Dicker's field goal was drilled from 52 yards, and he's now 19-for-21 on field-goal tries and 15-for-15 on extra points through 10 games this season. In a Chargers offense struggling mightily to score points, Dicker's fantasy value has tanked this season.

injuries.shortComment: Johnston caught one of two targets for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets. He added one yard on one rushing attempt.
injuries.longComment: Johnston was targeted on just 9.5 percent of Justin Herbert's 21 pass attempts against New York. The wideout has now caught exactly one pass in three straight games and in five of his last six contests. Johnston is a lightly targeted deep threat who will likely continue to see fewer looks if Ladd McConkey is able to maintain his health for an extended period.

injuries.shortComment: Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: After handling just four touches last week against the Ravens, Vidal saw his usage increase again as he recorded his most scrimmage yards since Week 5. This time, however, his additional volume came at the expense of Keaton Mitchell (knee), who left the game early. Omarion Hampton has re-established himself as the Chargers' clear No. 1 RB over the last few contests, but if Mitchell's injury proves to be serious, Vidal could have some deeper-league appeal with the No. 2 role all to himself. He'll look to take advantage of whatever opportunities he gets in Week 12 against the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Harris caught both his targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: With Ladd McConkey back in the lineup, Harris' role in the passing attack shrank after he'd turned 12 targets over the prior two games into an 8-92-0 line. Harris' fantasy appeal would collapse even further if Justin Herbert (concussion) ends up missing any time. The second-year wideout will at least get a promising matchup in Week 12 against a vulnerable Patriots secondary.

injuries.shortComment: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: His longest gain went for just 11 yards, but McConkey was deadly in the red zone, connecting with Justin Herbert on scores of 11 and six yards in the fourth quarter as the Chargers tried to mount a late comeback. Herbert was placed in the concussion protocol after the game after taking six sacks, and if he end up missing any time, it would put a big damper on McConkey's fantasy outlook with undrafted rookie DJ Uiagalelei being the Bolts' backup, unless Trey Lance (groin) is able to return from IR. McConkey has had plenty of trouble staying on the field himself this year, of course, and he'll take a 22-323-3 line on 32 targets through seven contests into a Week 12 clash with the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injuries.longComment: While he's still not seeing a consistent bell-cow workload, Hampton has turned his season around over the last three games, racking up 254 rushing yards and a TD while averaging 5.2 yards per carry. Keaton Mitchell left Sunday's game early with a knee injury, but his absence appeared to provide a bigger boost to Kimani Vidal, who wound up logging nine touches and 54 scrimmage yards. Hampton will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: Pipkins (knee) is active for Sunday's matchup against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Pipkins had been on IR since late September before being activated Saturday. The veteran offensive lineman is now set to give the Chargers' offensive line a boost. Pipkins may work in a rotational role, as Logan Taylor is "locked in" at left guard, per Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com.

injuries.shortComment: Waxter (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Waxter was cleared to return from a one-game absence due to an ankle injury. His availability gives the Chargers another contributor on special teams and depth in the secondary.

injuries.shortComment: McManus made all four of his field-goal tries and both of his point-after attempts Thursday in a 26-13 victory over Green Bay.
injuries.longComment: McManus scored the first six points of the game with 43-yard and 41-yard field goals in the first quarter. He added a 40-yarder in the fourth and a 30-yarder just before the end of the game. The veteran kicker has yet to try a field goal from 50-plus yards, but he's been everything the Rams could have asked for since taking over as the team's kicker in Week 7. Through five games, McManus is a perfect 9-for-9 on FG attempts and 16-for-16 on PAT tries.

injuries.shortComment: Daniels did not draw a target or log a touch Wednesday in a 26-13 win against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: After posting a career-high 61 percent offensive snap share in Week 10 against Arizona, Daniels logged just a 22 percent share Wednesday. That was still good for third among Rams wideouts behind Konata Mumpfield (90 percent) and Xavier Smith (23 percent), but Daniels didn't get a pass thrown his way. If Davante Adams (hamstring) is able to return to action in Week 13 against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3, Daniels' prospects for making an impact in the passing game will likely fall even further.

injuries.shortComment: Atwell didn't log a touch or target Wednesday in a 26-13 victory over Green Bay.
injuries.longComment: Atwell logged just six offensive snaps, behind all of fellow wideouts Konata Mumpfield (70), Xavier Smith (18) and CJ Daniels (17). The Rams also gave more offensive snaps to four different tight ends. Atwell's usage is especially notable given that both Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) didn't play. Nacua is out for the season, but Adams could return as soon as Week 13 versus Kansas City. Atwell is not an advised fantasy play moving forward even if Adams has to miss more contests.

injuries.shortComment: Smith gained 11 yards on two carries and caught his only target for four yards in a 26-13 win against Green Bay on Wednesday. He added 15 yards on his lone punt return.
injuries.longComment: Smith was used as a ball carrier for the first time this season and gained a chunk of yards on each of his totes. Aside from that, it was another quiet game for the third-year wideout, who hasn't really been able to take advantage of a wide open WR pecking order in the wake of injuries to star wideouts Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring). In fact, Smith has logged less than a 25 percent offensive snap share over the past two games with the pair of stud WRs absent, so it appears head coach Sean McVay is looking elsewhere to fill the void. As such, Smith doesn't have much fantasy value given that his primary role is in the return game.

injuries.shortComment: Rivers returned four kickoffs for 102 yards and did not log a snap on offense in Wednesday's 26-13 victory over the Packers.
injuries.longComment: The Rams stuffed the ball down the throat of Green Bay's defense, especially late, and ended up with a combined 241 yards on 47 rushes. However, Rivers didn't get a single one of those totes or even a snap on offense. The veteran running back logged season highs with 15 carries and 81 yards against Arizona in Week 10, but all of that work came in garbage time. It appears Rivers isn't going to be a factor outside of his return duties while both Kyren Williams and Blake Corum are healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Parkinson caught both of his targets for minus-1 yard in a 26-13 victory over the Packers on Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Parkinson logged a hefty 83 percent offensive snap count, highest among Los Angeles tight ends. His two receptions also tied for the team lead among players at the position, but he couldn't do much with those catches, gaining just one yard on the first and losing two yards on the second. However, Parkinson could take on an even more important role moving forward, as Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) both left Wednesday's win early and didn't return. If neither of those players is ready to suit up in Week 13 against Kansas City on Thursday, Dec. 3, Parkinson and untested rookie Max Klare would lead a tight-end corps that quarterback Matthew Stafford typically looks to often.

injuries.shortComment: Murray (leg) exited the Rams' locker room in a walking boot and on crutches following Wednesday's 26-13 victory over Green Bay, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Murray limped to the locker room early in the fourth quarter and never returned. Head coach Sean McVay didn't mention Murray's status following the win, but it sounds like he may be dealing with a more-than-minor injury. That would further deplete a Los Angeles offensive line that has been without starting left guard Steve Avila (hamstring) since he was hurt Week 9.

injuries.shortComment: Mumpfield brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.
injuries.longComment: Mumpfield set the pace in receiving yards for the Rams while also sharing the team lead in both receptions and targets. The 2025 seventh-round pick has now posted back-to-back productive games -- he had a 3-81-0 line in the Week 10 win over the Cardinals -- but Wednesday's performance could have been even more rewarding had an apparent two-yard touchdown grab just before the halfway point of the third quarter not been ruled incomplete on replay. Mumpfield should retain a solid No. 2 role even if Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) returns for a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3, and the former will retain his No. 1 standing if his star teammate remains sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Stafford completed 16 of 23 passes for 141 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. He also committed a fumble recovered by Los Angeles.
injuries.longComment: Playing his second game without both Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring), Stafford saw a notable downturn in his numbers and posted a new season low in passing yards. The veteran signal-caller also threw an interception for the fifth straight game, although his pick Wednesday didn't lead to any Packers points since Los Angeles intercepted Jordan Love just two plays later. Stafford also failed to throw a touchdown pass for only the second time this season, and the fact he also lost tight ends Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) to in-game injuries didn't help his cause. On the positive side, there's an outside chance Stafford has Adams back in the fold for a Week 13 home showdown against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.

injuries.shortComment: Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.
injuries.longComment: Williams had already been losing ground to Blake Corum in recent weeks, but the latter's takeover of the ground attack may have been finalized Wednesday with his career-best 184-yard, one-touchdown effort. Williams logged his final three carries on the Rams' final drive, but Corum was in the clear lead role throughout the majority of the night. Williams did add his seventh rushing touchdown of the campaign on a seven-yard run early in the second quarter, and his backseat role may have been influenced in part by the turf toe injury he's been dealing with for the past month. Nonetheless, Williams could be destined for a true complementary role if McVay opts to center the ground game on Corum moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Corum rushed 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday. He also recovered a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Corum's stock had already been trending firmly up in recent weeks, but Wednesday may ultimately go down as the day he formally took the reins of the ground attack from Kyren Williams. The 2024 third-round pick compiled a career-best rushing total while also becoming the first Rams running back to reach the 30-carry threshold in a game during the Sean McVay era that began in 2017. Corum has now logged double-digit carries in five consecutive games, and he capped off his night with productive runs of seven, nine and 29 yards on Los Angeles' game-sealing drive. Corum's fantasy value naturally skyrocketed with Wednesday's performance, and he'll look to build on the outstanding performance in a Week 13 home matchup against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3.

injuries.shortComment: Higbee exited Wednesday's game against the Packers with a chest injury and will not return, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
injuries.longComment: With Higbee forced out during the contest after Davis Allen (ankle) was injured earlier in the game, the Rams have only two healthy tight ends left. Colby Parkinson and Max Klare will play virtually every offensive snap the rest of the way for Los Angeles. Prior to leaving, Higbee caught one of three targets for 14 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Allen (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Wednesday night's game against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: The tight end was injured in the second quarter, so rookie Max Klare will need to play increased snaps as the TE3 in a Rams offense that uses more three-tight end sets than any team in the league. Prior to leaving, Allen caught a pair of passes for 14 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Kinchens was ejected from Wednesday night's game against the Packers after being penalized for an illegal hit to the head of Christian Watson in the second quarter, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Kinchens put a helmet-to-helmet hit on Watson along the sideline. Watson was injured on the play but was able to the locker room conscious and under his own power. Jaylen McCollough is in the game in the secondary in Kinchens' place.

injuries.shortComment: The Rams activated Dedich (hand) from injured reserve, and he does not carry an injury designation into Wednesday's game against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Dedich opened the regular season on injured reserve due to a hand injury. He's been cleared by medical staff to play Wednesday, and his availability gives the Rams more depth on the interior offensive line.

injuries.shortComment: The Rams activated Turner (groin) from injured reserve, and he is active for Wednesday's game against the Packers.
injuries.longComment: Turner has been officially cleared by medical staff to return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, and his presence gives the Rams additional depth in the pass rush alongside Ty Hamilton, Aaron Donald, Myles Garrett and Byron Young. Prior to his injury, Turner posted 22 tackles (seven solo) and two pass defenses across six regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Packers on Wednesday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
injuries.longComment: As has been the case all season, Simpson will be the Rams' emergency QB3, meaning he is prohibited from playing Wednesday unless both Matthew Stafford and Stetson Bennett are removed from the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Curl has no injury designation for Wednesday night's matchup against the Packers, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Curl posted two limited practices after beginning the week as a nonparticipant. The 27-year-old has started all 10 games for the Rams this season, recording 48 tackles (28 solo) and three pass deflections.

injuries.shortComment: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Tuesday that Garrett's absence from Monday's practice was a rest day and had nothing to do with his knee injury, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Garrett was limited in practice Sunday and Tuesday due to a knee injury, but it doesn't appear he will be impacted in Wednesday night's matchup against the Packers. The 30-year-old has three tackles (three solo), including 3.0 sacks and a forced fumble in three regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Ferguson initially seemed to be making good progress in his recovery from the ankle injury, as the Rams elected to open his 21-day evaluation window Nov. 4. However, Ferguson's activation from IR was delayed after he strained his hamstring shortly after he resumed working out, and he hasn't practiced in more than two weeks. Rather than the hamstring issue, McVay noted that the ankle injury remained the greater concern for Ferguson, who didn't improve as well as the Rams had hoped and now will require a procedure. Los Angeles will have to proceed without two of its top pass catchers for the remainder of the season, as Puka Nacua recently underwent an MCL surgery that entails an estimated 4-to-5-month recovery timeline.

injuries.shortComment: Simpson (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, David Furones reports.
injuries.longComment: Simpson missed the Dolphins' Week 11 loss to the Bills due to a knee injury. The reserve cornerback has since recovered from the issue and is set to log full participation in practices throughout Week 12 prep in anticipation of Sunday's game against the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Wayne (quadriceps) didn't practice Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injuries.longComment: Wayne has missed the Dolphins' last two games due to a quadriceps injury. He would need to practice in at least a limited capacity over the next two days to have a realistic chance of being available for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Brents (neck) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injuries.longComment: Brents was initially diagnosed with a shoulder injury during the Dolphins' Week 12 loss to the Bills. He was tagged with a neck injury on Wednesday's report, and he'll have two more chances to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's AFC East tilt against the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Anderson recorded 12 total tackles (eight solo), including 1.0 sacks, and also intercepted a pass during Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Anderson was thrust into a starting role at safety with Dante Trader (shoulder/groin) inactive, and he made the most of his opportunity. Anderson finished second on the team in tackles while intercepting Bills quarterback Josh Allen in the second quarter and sacking him in the third quarter. If Trader remains sidelined again in Week 12, Anderson will likely get a shot at an encore performance against the Jets on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Kacmarek went without a target while logging 21 of 57 snaps on offense in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: After drawing at least one target in each of the previous three games, Kacmarek failed to draw a look from quarterback Kyle McCord, who connected with seven different pass catchers on the day. Kacmarek ran routes on just six of his 21 snaps, as the Dolphins continue to utilize him mainly as a blocker when he's on the field.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks recorded eight tackles (two solo) in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: The eight tackles were actually Brooks' second fewest in a game this season. After leading the NFL with 183 tackles (99 solo) last season and being named a First-Team All-Pro, Brooks has just 92 tackles (40 solo), including 1.0 sacks, two pass breakups and a forced fumble across 10 starts in 2026. He's still on pace for a sixth straight 100-tackle campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez recorded 13 tackles (eight solo) and an interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: With Miami trailing 20-3 in the second quarter, Rodriguez picked off Josh Allen and returned it to Buffalo's 22-yard line to help set up a Dolphins field goal. It was the second-round rookie linebacker's second interception of the season, and his 13 tackles were his third-highest total in a single game. He's up to 93 tackles (44 solo), including 1.0 sacks, two interceptions and a forced fumble while playing 99 percent of the Dolphins' defensive snaps.

injuries.shortComment: Wright carried the ball five times for 10 yards and returned three kickoffs for 79 yards during Miami's loss to the Bills on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Wright continues to struggle rushing the ball this season, averaging just 1.6 yards per carry across 30 rush attempts. The 23-year-old will look to improve upon his performance during the Week 12 matchup versus the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Allen logged 80 kickoff-return yards in the Dolphins' 26-9 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Allen played 16 special-teams snaps in the contest. The running back did not log an offensive snap, leaving all the rushing work to Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright.

injuries.shortComment: Bell caught one of his four targets for eight yards in the Dolphins' 26-9 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Bell saw 34 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest but was inefficient with his opportunities. The Dolphins continues to try to involve the third-round rookie, but he's been frequently out of sync with quarterbacks Malik Willis (IR, abdomen) and Kyle McCord.

injuries.shortComment: Coleman failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: With Chris Bell (knee) back from his absence, Coleman reverted to WR4 duties for Miami, playing just 12 of 57 offensive snaps. He has no fantasy appeal while Caleb Douglas, Malik Washington and Bell are healthy. Coleman has been extremely inefficient through 10 games this season, catching just nine of 28 targets for 88 yards and two touchdowns.

injuries.shortComment: Tolbert caught his only target for 17 yards during Sunday's 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
injuries.longComment: Tolbert played just eight of the Dolphins' 55 offensive snaps in Week 11, and he drew just one target for the third time in his last five games. Miami will probably continue to lean primarily on Malik Washington, Caleb Douglas and Chris Bell at wide receiver in a Week 12 matchup versus the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Carlson reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Carlson was signed to the Dolphins' practice squad this past Tuesday, two weeks after being released by the Saints. He served as the Dolphins' kicker Sunday against the Bills, when he made all three of his field-goal attempts in a 27-9 loss for Miami. The Dolphins do not have a kicker on the 53-man roster, so Carlson is almost certain to be elevated for Week 12 against the Jets on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: The Dolphins opened Harrison's (hamstring) 21-day practice window Monday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injuries.longComment: Harrison suffered a hamstring injury in Week 1 that landed him on injured reserve. The fact the Dolphins opted to open his practice window after nine weeks suggests Harrison may be nearing a return.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
injuries.longComment: That said, per Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com, Hafley added that the Dolphins will evaluate the QB's status again depending on how he feels at the end of his minimum required stay on IR. For now, Willis is out for at least three more games, with Kyle McCord currently filling in as 1-9 Miami's starting signal-caller.

injuries.shortComment: Washington caught three of six targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He rushed two times for 11 yards.
injuries.longComment: Washington's six targets were third on the team, trailing Caleb Douglas (10) and Greg Dulcich (seven) on a day when Kyle McCord attempted 33 passes. Washington has just one touchdown this season and has yet to reach 70 receiving yards in any game in 2026. There's not much to like about the wideout's fantasy prospects moving forward this season.

injuries.shortComment: Dulcich caught two of seven targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injuries.longComment: Dulcich finished second on the team in targets behind wide receiver Caleb Douglas (10), but he failed to exceed 20 receiving yards for the third straight week. The tight end hasn't scored a touchdown this season, and his next chance will come in Week 12 against the Jets.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (thigh) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Smith is working through a thigh injury that he likely picked up during the Vikings' Week 11 loss to the 49ers. He was listed as a DNP on Wednesday's estimated report, so his ability to practice in a limited capacity Thursday indicates that he is progressing in his recovery, and a full session Friday could be enough for him to avoid a designation ahead of Sunday's game against Atlanta.

injuries.shortComment: Price (knee/groin) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Price has been limited in each of the first two practices of Week 12 prep due to knee and groin injuries that he likely sustained during the Vikings' 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Week 11. A full practice Friday would presumably be enough for Price to avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons. He has a 6-75-1 receiving line on as many targets over his last two outings while operating in an expanded role on offense in the absence of Jordan Addison (thumb), the latter of whom is unlikely to play against Atlanta.

injuries.shortComment: Murray (hamstring) was listed as limited on Thursday's injury report.
injuries.longComment: Murray appears to be drawing closer to being active for the first time since Week 8, but he may need to practice fully Friday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Sunday's contest against the Falcons. He's missed the last three games due to a Grade 2 hamstring strain, and he likely will slot in as Kirk Cousins' direct backup once the former is healthy enough to suit up.

injuries.shortComment: Felton (hip) was listed as a full participant on Thursday's injury report.
injuries.longComment: Felton was limited at Wednesday's walkthrough by a hip injury, but his ability to get back to full one day later gives him the all clear for Sunday's game versus the Falcons. Assuming Jordan Addison (thumb) misses a third consecutive contest in Week 12, Felton again will be a candidate for an expanded role, which has translated to nine catches (on 17 targets) for 75 yards the last two outings.

injuries.shortComment: Addison (thumb) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's injury report.
injuries.longComment: Addison's next listing on an injury report that isn't a DNP will be his first since Nov. 13, when he suffered a thumb injury that required surgery and so far has sidelined him for two games. Head coach Kevin O'Connell relayed to Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune on Monday that Addison is "progressing well" in his recovery but is unlikely to play Sunday against the Falcons. Ultimately, Addison's status for Week 12 may be clarified once the Vikings post Friday's practice report.

injuries.shortComment: Rodgers (quadriceps) did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Rodgers was unable to play against the 49ers in Week 11 due to a quadriceps injury. He hasn't been cleared to practice since picking up the injury during last Thursday's session, and he'll have two more chances to return to practice ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Metellus posted five assisted tackles during the Vikings' 35-10 loss to the 49ers on Sunday in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: It was the first time this season that Metellus failed to record a solo tackle, and his 83.3 percent snap count on defense was his lowest of the season, although that was partly due to the Vikings resting their starters in the fourth quarter. Metellus has accumulated 68 tackles (32 solo), including 0.5 sacks, and four pass defenses across 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Wilson recorded 1.0 sacks during the Vikings' 35-10 loss to the 49ers on Sunday in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Wilson had only one tackle Sunday, but it was an impactful one as he took down Brock Purdy for a seven-yard loss in the third quarter to force the 49ers to punt on the next play. In his five outings since the Vikings' Week 6 bye, Wilson has accumulated 32 tackles (20 solo), including 3.5 sacks.

injuries.shortComment: Yurosek failed to draw a target while playing 29 of the Vikings' 67 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Since being reinstated from injured reserve in Week 5, Yurosek has cleared 40 percent snap shares in five of the Vikings' ensuing six games. However, he remains a fringe part of the passing attack, having thus far mustered a 3-41-0 receiving line on four targets. He ran routes on just nine of his 29 snaps in Week 11, with Yurosek mainly serving as a blocker during his time on the field.

injuries.shortComment: Cashman recorded nine tackles (four solo) in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: After missing the Week 10 win over the Packers while dealing with a concussion, Cashman returned from the one-game absence to play 93 percent of the defensive snaps Sunday. He's up to 85 tackles (45 solo), including a career-high 4.5 sacks, seven pass breakups and a fumble recovery across nine games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Bartholomew caught one of three targets for five yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: With T.J. Hockenson back in the lineup after being inactive Week 10, Bartholomew played just 18 of 67 offensive snaps as the Vikings' third tight end, also behind Ben Yurosek. Bartholomew has 11 catches for 95 yards and a touchdown on 15 targets across 10 games this season.

injuries.shortComment: Reichard went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Reichard failed to get the Vikings on the board in the first quarter after his 55-yard field-goal attempt missed to the left. He had the stadium's altitude in his favor when lining up for a 71-yarder on the final play of the first half, but what would have been an NFL record-breaking kick fell just short. Reichard is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts through 10 regular-season games, and each of those misses have come from 50-plus yards. The Vikings will be home in a controlled environment for three of their next four games, starting in Week 12 against the Falcons on Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Mason rushed 11 times for 38 yards while catching his lone target for minus-1 yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Mason had one more carry and eight more rushing yards than Aaron Jones, but Jones' totals included an 11-yard touchdown run in the first quarter. They have worked in a near-even split when both veteran RBs have been healthy, but Mason hasn't scored since Week 1. Between his lack of TDs and minimal involvement as a pass catcher (three receptions for six yards in six games), Mason hasn't provided much fantasy value ahead of a Week 12 home game against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Jones rushed eight times for 30 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Jones tied the game with an 11-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, but the 49ers outscored the Vikings 21-3 in the second quarter, forcing Minnesota into a more pass-heavy approach. Jordan Mason led the team with 38 rushing yards on 11 carries. Jones and Mason should continue to split carries in Week 12 against the Falcons, with Jones offering greater upside as a pass catcher.

injuries.shortComment: Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: In his return from a one-game absence, Hockenson finished second on the team in receiving yards behind Justin Jefferson's 86. Hockenson showed promising chemistry with Kirk Cousins after the veteran TE sat out Cousins' return to Minnesota during the Week 10 win over Green Bay. Cousins was under center for the Vikings in the 2023 regular season, when Hockenson set career highs with 95 catches for 960 yards. Hockenson hasn't surpassed 455 yards in a regular season since, though he's on pace to do so this year, with 41 catches for 383 yards and three touchdowns through nine appearances heading into a Week 12 home game against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Cousins completed 26 of 38 passes for 235 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for no gain.
injuries.longComment: After throwing a pick-six among his three interceptions when he faced San Francisco's defense in his final game with the Raiders in Week 9, Cousins had another interception returned for a touchdown by the 49ers in the second quarter of Sunday's loss. The Vikings took a 28-10 deficit into the halftime locker room, and Cousins was unable to orchestrate a comeback before Minnesota waved the white flag and inserted Carson Wentz for its final drive. Cousins is still strengthening his grasp on the offense two games into his reunion with the Vikings ahead of a Week 12 visit from the Falcons, with whom Cousins spent the previous two seasons.

injuries.shortComment: Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Jefferson has experienced an uptick in usage since the Vikings reacquired Kirk Cousins. The star WR has 16 catches for 160 yards on 22 targets in two games with Cousins, though Jefferson hasn't scored since Week 8. Jefferson fumbled at the end of a 25-yard catch in the third quarter, turning what would have been one of his best plays of the night into a lowlight. Another heavy dose of targets from Cousins likely awaits Jefferson in Week 12 against the Falcons.

injuries.shortComment: Brosmer (coach's decision) is inactive but operating as the Vikings' emergency third QB on Sunday night versus the 49ers.
injuries.longComment: Brosmer will operate as the team's No. 3 option at QB for the second straight week. He will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Kirk Cousins and primary backup Carson Wentz are forced out of the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Jones -- who was managing a shoulder injury during Week 11 prep -- was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a contributor on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Van Ginkel (quadriceps) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.
injuries.longComment: Van Ginkel's practice reps were limited Wednesday and Thursday while managing a quadriceps injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the Packers. He was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for the veteran edge rusher to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. In Van Ginkel's four outings since the Vikings' Week 6 bye, he has accumulated 14 tackles (eight solo), including 4.5 sacks, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery.

injuries.shortComment: Doubs (shoulder) was listed as a limited practice participant on Thursday's estimated report.
injuries.longComment: The Patriots didn't hold a practice on Thanksgiving Day, but Doubs has opened Week 12 prep listed as a limited participant in back-to-back sessions. The fifth-year wide receiver was designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday, and he would need to be activated from IR in order to be available for Sunday's road game against the Chargers. Doubs' return would bolster a Patriots' wide receiver group that will likely be without A.J. Brown (hamstring) for Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Brown (hamstring) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's practice estimate.
injuries.longComment: Mike Reiss of ESPN.com relayed earlier this week that Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel doesn't anticipate Brown playing Sunday against the Chargers, and the wideout's consecutive 'DNP' listings Wednesday and Thursday haven't changed that narrative. Friday's final injury report will clarify whether Brown has any chance of playing this weekend, but on the plus side for the Patriots, it's possible that fellow WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is activated off IR ahead of Week 12 action.

injuries.shortComment: Stevenson was not listed on the Patriots' practice report Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Stevenson hurt his knee in Week 9 against Green Bay and initially appeared slated to miss multiple games. However, he surprisingly was able to suit up in Week 10 against Detroit in Munich, Germany, though he logged just a 44 percent offensive snap share and gained only five yards on seven touches. Stevenson is now off the injury report entirely to begin Week 12 prep following New England's Week 11 bye, suggesting that the knee issue is no longer a concern. The veteran running back commented Wednesday on his ability to suit up in Week 10, attributing it to "a bunch of recovery" and sharing, "(The trainers) did a good job of just getting me available again... Leg wasn't feeling 100 percent, but I was well enough to go out there and participate with the team and try to help them out a little bit," per Sophie Weller of Patriots Wire. With no practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep, Stevenson should be set to suit up this Sunday  in Los Angeles against the Chargers, when he'll be taking handoffs from QB Tommy DeVito.

injuries.shortComment: Rouse (concussion) did not practice Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Rouse is in the league's concussion protocol, which prevented him from playing in Week 10 against the Lions in Munich. Despite the extra rest courtesy of the Week 11 bye, the third-year pro has not progressed enough in his recovery to return to practice. Even if he practices over the coming days, an independent neurologist would need to clear Rouse from protocol in order for him to be available for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injuries.shortComment: Schooler (hamstring) was not listed on the Patriots' injury report Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Schooler did not play in Week 10 against the Lions due to hamstring injury, and he missed the Patriots' four prior games while recovering from a back issue. His absence from Wednesday's report indicates that Schooler will be available for Sunday's game against the Chargers. He has four tackles (two solo) across five regular-season games while mostly contributing on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Brown (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Brown did not play in the Patriots' Week 10 loss to the Lions in Munich due to a knee injury that he sustained against the Packers in Week 9. With a full practice under his belt, Brown is on track to play against the Chargers on Sunday and should reclaim his starting spot at left guard while Walter Rouse reverts to a depth role on the offensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Davis (knee) didn't practice Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Davis didn't travel with the Patriots to Munich for Week 10 against the Lions due to a knee injury that he sustained against the Packers in Week 9. Even with the extra rest courtesy of the bye, Davis has not been cleared by medical staff to return to practice. He would need to log a limited session over the next two days to have a realistic shot of playing Sunday against the Chargers.
